key: Check measured winter chilling, spring frost, drainage and rain near picking. The older KZN guide regarded commercial suitability there as still under trial; a broad climate-zone label does not replace current local advice.
english: Check measured winter chilling, spring frost, drainage and rain near picking. The older KZN guide regarded commercial suitability there as still under trial; a broad climate-zone label does not replace current local advice.
draft: Kontroleer gemete winterkoue, lenteryp, dreinering en reën naby pluktyd. Die ouer KZN-gids het kommersiële geskiktheid daar as steeds onder proefneming beskou; 'n breë klimaatsone-etiket vervang nie huidige plaaslike advies nie.

key: Coastal plant; allow for thorns near children and paths.
english: Coastal plant; allow for thorns near children and paths.
draft: Kusplant; hou rekening met dorings naby kinders en paadjies.

key: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
english: Cold-area check: these subtropical references do not establish suitability here. Confirm a frost-protected position before buying.
draft: Kontrole vir koue gebiede: hierdie subtropiese verwysings bewys nie geskiktheid hier nie. Bevestig 'n plek wat teen ryp beskerm is voordat jy koop.

key: Confirm Carpobrotus deliciosus; do not substitute another sour-fig species merely because the common name matches.
english: Confirm Carpobrotus deliciosus; do not substitute another sour-fig species merely because the common name matches.
draft: Bevestig Carpobrotus deliciosus; moenie 'n ander sour-fig-spesie in die plek daarvan gebruik bloot omdat die algemene naam ooreenstem nie.

key: Confirm Rhoicissus digitata; other wild-grape species have different descriptions and cannot supply its dates.
english: Confirm Rhoicissus digitata; other wild-grape species have different descriptions and cannot supply its dates.
draft: Bevestig Rhoicissus digitata; ander wild-grape-spesies het verskillende beskrywings en kan nie sy datums verskaf nie.

key: Confirm botanical identity before using this catalogue entry as a separate fruit enterprise. Do not count it twice merely because the same plant is also labelled C. bispinosa.
english: Confirm botanical identity before using this catalogue entry as a separate fruit enterprise. Do not count it twice merely because the same plant is also labelled C. bispinosa.
draft: Bevestig botaniese identiteit voordat jy hierdie kataloguminskrywing as 'n aparte vrugonderneming gebruik. Moenie dit twee keer tel bloot omdat dieselfde plant ook as C. bispinosa gemerk is nie.

key: Confirm cultivar-specific chilling and spring frost risk. Mean winter temperature is not a chill-hour measurement.
english: Confirm cultivar-specific chilling and spring frost risk. Mean winter temperature is not a chill-hour measurement.
draft: Bevestig kultivarspesifieke kouebehoefte en die risiko van lenteryp. Gemiddelde wintertemperatuur is nie 'n meting van koue-ure nie.

key: Confirm exact species with a qualified indigenous nursery. Do not substitute genus-level berry claims for identification.
english: Confirm exact species with a qualified indigenous nursery. Do not substitute genus-level berry claims for identification.
draft: Bevestig die presiese spesie met 'n gekwalifiseerde inheemse kwekery. Moenie bewerings oor bessies op genusvlak in die plek van identifikasie gebruik nie.

key: Discuss the named SA trial cultivars with a local seed supplier or extension adviser. Current purchase availability and suitability for this site are unverified; do not substitute a cultivar silently.
english: Discuss the named SA trial cultivars with a local seed supplier or extension adviser. Current purchase availability and suitability for this site are unverified; do not substitute a cultivar silently.
draft: Bespreek die benoemde SA-proefkultivars met 'n plaaslike saadverskaffer of voorligtingsadviseur. Huidige beskikbaarheid vir aankoop en geskiktheid vir hierdie terrein is ongeverifieer; moenie stilweg 'n ander kultivar in die plek gebruik nie.

key: Documented berry-use caution
english: Documented berry-use caution
draft: Gedokumenteerde waarskuwing oor bessiegebruik

key: Dried-fruit flour is a documented traditional end use, not a supplied safe storage duration. October–March is flowering.
english: Dried-fruit flour is a documented traditional end use, not a supplied safe storage duration. October–March is flowering.
draft: Meel van gedroogde vrugte is 'n gedokumenteerde tradisionele eindgebruik, nie 'n verskafte veilige bergingstydperk nie. Oktober–Maart is die blomtyd.

key: Edibility is recorded for this exact variety; do not apply the common name boer-bean to every species as food evidence.
english: Edibility is recorded for this exact variety; do not apply the common name boer-bean to every species as food evidence.
draft: Eetbaarheid is vir hierdie presiese variëteit aangeteken; moenie die algemene naam boer-bean op elke spesie as bewys van voedsel toepas nie.

key: Edible-part and safety review
english: Edible-part and safety review
draft: Hersiening van eetbare deel en veiligheid

key: Food is the berry; the same SANBI account reports poisonous tuberous roots. September–June describes berry occurrence, not a measured ripe-picking interval.
english: Food is the berry; the same SANBI account reports poisonous tuberous roots. September–June describes berry occurrence, not a measured ripe-picking interval.
draft: Die voedsel is die bessie; dieselfde SANBI-beskrywing meld giftige knolwortels. September–Junie beskryf wanneer bessies voorkom, nie 'n gemete tydperk vir die pluk van ryp vrugte nie.

key: Food is the ripe berry. Fruit appearance from February and overlapping flowers/fruit do not establish a complete ripe-picking window.
english: Food is the ripe berry. Fruit appearance from February and overlapping flowers/fruit do not establish a complete ripe-picking window.
draft: Die voedsel is die ryp bessie. Die verskyning van vrugte vanaf Februarie en oorvleuelende blomme/vrugte bepaal nie 'n volledige venster vir die pluk van ryp vrugte nie.

key: Food is the ripe black fruit. Spring flowers do not supply ripe-harvest months; growth rate is not food-bearing age.
english: Food is the ripe black fruit. Spring flowers do not supply ripe-harvest months; growth rate is not food-bearing age.
draft: Die voedsel is die ryp swart vrug. Lenteblomme verskaf nie maande vir die oes van ryp vrugte nie; groeitempo is nie die ouderdom waarop dit voedsel dra nie.

key: Food is the ripe fruit. Main flowering in autumn/winter and fruit shortly afterwards do not establish named picking months.
english: Food is the ripe fruit. Main flowering in autumn/winter and fruit shortly afterwards do not establish named picking months.
draft: Die voedsel is die ryp vrug. Hoofblom in die herfs/winter en vrugte kort daarna bepaal nie benoemde plukmaande nie.

key: For eggs with dependable feed and water, consider commercial layers. For eggs and meat, Potchefstroom Koekoek is a dual-purpose option; Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck are other ARC-conserved choices. Confirm supplier vaccination, age and care requirements.
english: For eggs with dependable feed and water, consider commercial layers. For eggs and meat, Potchefstroom Koekoek is a dual-purpose option; Venda, Ovambo and Naked Neck are other ARC-conserved choices. Confirm supplier vaccination, age and care requirements.
draft: Vir eiers met betroubare voer en water, oorweeg kommersiële lêhenne. Vir eiers en vleis is Potchefstroom Koekoek 'n dubbeldoel-opsie; Venda, Ovambo en Naked Neck is ander keuses wat deur die ARC bewaar word. Bevestig die verskaffer se inenting, ouderdom en versorgingsvereistes.

key: Frost sensitivity and drainage constrain the site. Year-round planting at Hluhluwe is a planting reference, not an all-year household picking window; cooler sites use warmer planting months.
english: Frost sensitivity and drainage constrain the site. Year-round planting at Hluhluwe is a planting reference, not an all-year household picking window; cooler sites use warmer planting months.
draft: Rypgevoeligheid en dreinering beperk die terrein. Plant deur die jaar by Hluhluwe is 'n plantverwysing, nie 'n venster vir huishoudelike pluk deur die hele jaar nie; koeler terreine gebruik warmer plantmaande.

key: Frost- and drought-hardy; establishment care still matters.
english: Frost- and drought-hardy; establishment care still matters.
draft: Bestand teen ryp en droogte; versorging tydens vestiging is steeds belangrik.

key: Frost-free forest reference; confirm a fruiting female and pollen source.
english: Frost-free forest reference; confirm a fruiting female and pollen source.
draft: Rypvrye woudverwysing; bevestig 'n vrugdraende vroulike plant en stuifmeelbron.

key: Frost-free regional reference; male and female trees are separate.
english: Frost-free regional reference; male and female trees are separate.
draft: Rypvrye streeksverwysing; manlike en vroulike bome is apart.

key: Full production around years 12–13 in the general KZN guide. Cultivar, propagation, density and management affect actual output; mature ages do not automatically create an annual kg/tree curve.
english: Full production around years 12–13 in the general KZN guide. Cultivar, propagation, density and management affect actual output; mature ages do not automatically create an annual kg/tree curve.
draft: Volle produksie rondom jaar 12–13 in die algemene KZN-gids. Kultivar, voortplanting, digtheid en bestuur beïnvloed werklike opbrengs; volwasse ouderdomme skep nie outomaties 'n jaarlikse kg/boom-kurwe nie.

key: Government guidance identifies pods, severe-frost exclusion, irrigation in arid areas and variation between seedling trees. It recommends grafted material and pollen provision; not every tree has the same crop.
english: Government guidance identifies pods, severe-frost exclusion, irrigation in arid areas and variation between seedling trees. It recommends grafted material and pollen provision; not every tree has the same crop.
draft: Regeringsriglyne identifiseer peule, uitsluiting van strawwe ryp, besproeiing in droë gebiede en variasie tussen saailingbome. Dit beveel geënte materiaal en voorsiening vir stuifmeel aan; nie elke boom het dieselfde oes nie.

key: Grafted mango stock in the KZN guide generally begins bearing after 3–4 years. Context is frost-free tropical/warm subtropical production with low humidity at flowering, including dry Zululand, Valley Bushveld and Lowveld. The text distinguishes grafted stock from seed-raised Peach/Sabre; do not apply this age to an unrecorded seedling or infer yearly kg.
english: Grafted mango stock in the KZN guide generally begins bearing after 3–4 years. Context is frost-free tropical/warm subtropical production with low humidity at flowering, including dry Zululand, Valley Bushveld and Lowveld. The text distinguishes grafted stock from seed-raised Peach/Sabre; do not apply this age to an unrecorded seedling or infer yearly kg.
draft: Geënte mangovoorraad in die KZN-gids begin gewoonlik ná 3–4 jaar dra. Die konteks is rypvrye tropiese/warm subtropiese produksie met lae humiditeit tydens blom, insluitend droë Zoeloeland, Valley Bushveld en die Laeveld. Die teks onderskei geënte voorraad van Peach/Sabre wat uit saad gekweek is; moenie hierdie ouderdom op 'n onaangetekende saailing toepas of jaarlikse kg aflei nie.

key: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
english: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
draft: Geënte voorraad dra gewoonlik eers rondom 3–4 jaar en kan onder die gids se toestande 20 jaar of langer produktief bly. Bome wat uit saad gekweek is, is 'n aparte geval van plantmateriaal. Ryp, nat blomtoestande in die lente, kultivar en vestiging in die veld moet gekontroleer word; lewensduur is nie 'n ouderdom-opbrengs-kurwe nie.

key: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
english: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
draft: Hass op Duke 7, aanvanklik 200 bome/ha by Bruyns Hill (Natalse Middelland bioklimatiese groep 2), met intensiewe besproeiing en voeding. Ouderdom 3: 10,000 kg/ha; ouderdom 6: 20,000 kg/ha; volhoubare gemiddelde ongeveer 22,500 kg/ha. Die digtheid in dieselfde studie laat ekwivalente van 50 kg/boom op ouderdom 3 en 100 kg/boom op ouderdom 6 toe; daar is nie 'n verwysing vir elke tussenliggende ouderdom nie. Hierdie boordmaatstawwe is afhanklik van goeie hulpbronne, 'n vergelykbare klimaat en tydige boordbestuur, insluitend Phytophthora-beheer en uitdunning; moenie plaashoeveelhede outomaties invul nie.

key: Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
english: Imperial has a December reference at Robertson. This is a local trial candidate, not advice for frost-free coastal KZN.
draft: Imperial het 'n Desember-verwysing by Robertson. Dit is 'n plaaslike proefkandidaat, nie advies vir rypvrye kus-KZN nie.

key: KZN advice describes Vaccinium species and lists rabbiteye cultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue and Climax. This reference is not specific to southern highbush blueberries.
english: KZN advice describes Vaccinium species and lists rabbiteye cultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue and Climax. This reference is not specific to southern highbush blueberries.
draft: KZN-advies beskryf Vaccinium-spesies en lys die rabbiteye-kultivars Tifblue, Beckyblue en Climax. Hierdie verwysing is nie spesifiek vir southern highbush-bloubessies nie.

key: Keep preserved-stock dates separate from fruit picking; a canning end use does not establish safe shelf life.
english: Keep preserved-stock dates separate from fruit picking; a canning end use does not establish safe shelf life.
draft: Hou datums vir gepreserveerde voorraad apart van vrugpluk; 'n eindgebruik vir inmaak bepaal nie 'n veilige raklewe nie.

key: Keep this tree in mapped inventory and do not count it as household food until identity and a safe edible-leaf preparation are reviewed.
english: Keep this tree in mapped inventory and do not count it as household food until identity and a safe edible-leaf preparation are reviewed.
draft: Hou hierdie boom in die gekarteerde inventaris en moenie dit as huishoudelike voedsel tel nie totdat identiteit en 'n veilige voorbereiding van eetbare blare hersien is.

key: Langkloof, Little Karoo, sandy loam: budgeted year 3 product quantity 10,000 kg/ha. This is a commercial enterprise-budget assumption, not a field measurement. The budget gives no matched tree density, rootstock or cultivar; do not convert to kg/tree, apply it to an isolated young tree or interpolate other ages. Citation uses table excerpts: the total is in the Quantity column, and the apple product-income rows use Kg; the one-hectare land basis is stated in the heading.
english: Langkloof, Little Karoo, sandy loam: budgeted year 3 product quantity 10,000 kg/ha. This is a commercial enterprise-budget assumption, not a field measurement. The budget gives no matched tree density, rootstock or cultivar; do not convert to kg/tree, apply it to an isolated young tree or interpolate other ages. Citation uses table excerpts: the total is in the Quantity column, and the apple product-income rows use Kg; the one-hectare land basis is stated in the heading.
draft: Langkloof, Klein-Karoo, sanderige leem: begrote produkhoeveelheid in jaar 3 van 10,000 kg/ha. Dit is 'n kommersiële ondernemingsbegroting-aanname, nie 'n veldmeting nie. Die begroting gee geen ooreenstemmende boomdigtheid, onderstam of kultivar nie; moenie na kg/boom omskakel, dit op 'n geïsoleerde jong boom toepas of ander ouderdomme interpoleer nie. Die aanhaling gebruik tabeluittreksels: die totaal is in die Quantity-kolom, en die appel-produkinkomsterye gebruik Kg; die grondbasis van een hektaar word in die opskrif gestel.

key: Large amounts of its leaves can taint dairy milk, according to SANBI; this is not a ration recommendation.
english: Large amounts of its leaves can taint dairy milk, according to SANBI; this is not a ration recommendation.
draft: Groot hoeveelhede van sy blare kan volgens SANBI melk van melkkoeie 'n bysmaak gee; dit is nie 'n rantsoenaanbeveling nie.

key: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
english: Match the cultivar to table olives or oil. Check drainage, irrigation and winter conditions; humid summer rainfall can bring disease problems.
draft: Laat die kultivar by tafelolywe of olie pas. Kontroleer dreinering, besproeiing en wintertoestande; vogtige somerreën kan siekteprobleme meebring.

key: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
english: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
draft: Laat die kultivar by die mikroklimaat pas; vermy strawwe ryp en swak gedreineerde grond.

key: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.
english: Match the selected duration type and sowing date to local frost, rainfall and water availability; the trials retain their own conditions.
draft: Laat die gekose duurtipe en saaidatum by plaaslike ryp, reënval en beskikbaarheid van water pas; die proewe behou hul eie toestande.

key: Match this frost-sensitive plant to dry saline/coastal conditions. Its accumulated salts can return to the soil as plants die.
english: Match this frost-sensitive plant to dry saline/coastal conditions. Its accumulated salts can return to the soil as plants die.
draft: Laat hierdie rypgevoelige plant by droë soutagtige/kustoestande pas. Sy opgehoopte soute kan na die grond terugkeer wanneer plante doodgaan.

key: Match warm summers with cool, frost-free winter conditions for flowering; protect from wind and keep young plants watered.
english: Match warm summers with cool, frost-free winter conditions for flowering; protect from wind and keep young plants watered.
draft: Laat warm somers by koel, rypvrye wintertoestande vir blom pas; beskerm teen wind en hou jong plante natgelei.

key: New rainy-season growth gives the best tops; wash off coastal sand thoroughly and boil for the documented vegetable preparation. August–November flowering is not leaf availability.
english: New rainy-season growth gives the best tops; wash off coastal sand thoroughly and boil for the documented vegetable preparation. August–November flowering is not leaf availability.
draft: Nuwe groei in die reënseisoen gee die beste punte; was kussand deeglik af en kook vir die gedokumenteerde groentevoorbereiding. Blom in Augustus–November is nie die beskikbaarheid van blare nie.

key: Observed frost conflicts with this proposed reference; confirm a protected growing position before buying.
english: Observed frost conflicts with this proposed reference; confirm a protected growing position before buying.
draft: Waargenome ryp bots met hierdie voorgestelde verwysing; bevestig 'n beskermde groeiplek voordat jy koop.

key: Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
english: Pick at the intended green, black or oil stage. Processing and safe kept-stock conditions must be recorded separately.
draft: Pluk op die beoogde groen, swart of oliestadium. Verwerking en veilige toestande vir gehoue voorraad moet apart aangeteken word.

key: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
english: Plan around actual calving/kidding and lactation. Dry animals do not supply milk.
draft: Beplan rondom werklike kalwing/lamming en laktasie. Droë diere verskaf nie melk nie.

key: Poisonous parts must remain visible
english: Poisonous parts must remain visible
draft: Giftige dele moet sigbaar bly

key: Protect young plants from cold; use well-drained soil in sun or semi-shade. SANBI describes frost tenderness and tolerance of sea breezes.
english: Protect young plants from cold; use well-drained soil in sun or semi-shade. SANBI describes frost tenderness and tolerance of sea breezes.
draft: Beskerm jong plante teen koue; gebruik goed gedreineerde grond in son of halfskaduwee. SANBI beskryf rypgevoeligheid en verdraagsaamheid vir seebries.

key: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
english: Provide climbing support. Tuberous roots are poisonous; children should not forage unsupervised.
draft: Voorsien klimondersteuning. Die knolwortels is giftig; kinders moet nie sonder toesig kos soek nie.

key: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
english: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
draft: Teken die pluk van koffiebessies apart van droog, dop en brand aan. Moenie die maande van gebrande verpakte voorraad as die kalender vir vars oes gebruik nie.

key: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
english: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
draft: Teken eetbare ongeopende koppe volgens plantgroep aan; moenie maande van oop blomme as plukmaande gebruik nie.

key: Record fresh cuttings and dried tea output separately; no automatic drying conversion or safe storage duration is assigned.
english: Record fresh cuttings and dried tea output separately; no automatic drying conversion or safe storage duration is assigned.
draft: Teken vars snysels en gedroogde tee-opbrengs apart aan; geen outomatiese droogomskakeling of veilige bergingstydperk word toegeken nie.

key: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
english: Record local ripe picking dates and output. Foreign cultivar seasons do not establish a South African season.
draft: Teken plaaslike plukdatums vir ryp vrugte en opbrengs aan. Buitelandse kultivarseisoene bepaal nie 'n Suid-Afrikaanse seisoen nie.

key: Regional reference: frost-free strawberry
english: Regional reference: frost-free strawberry

key: Yield points use the conservative end of published commercial KZN benchmarks where that crop is listed. They compare plans; they do not predict this household's harvest. The warm/light-frost windows, spacing and duration use the official tables where those tables cover the crop; catalog fallbacks and other regional patterns still need local confirmation. Bed occupancy uses the upper published maturity/picking endpoint so two crops are not booked onto the same ground, but the source says these times are approximate and assume optimum conditions; actual crops may mature later. Every later sowing or transplant is conditional on observing that the previous crop is finished and the bed is clear. The app does not split a crop-cycle total into invented monthly kilograms. Auto-suggest only ranks crops with verified yield, duration and field-spacing support. A family plan starts from a supported diverse mix; an exact crop list becomes a strict whitelist. It requires irrigation because intensive succession without a farm water plan is not defensible. Its packing is a transparent heuristic, not proof of a global maximum or of a physical row layout. Commercial ranking is fresh weight per crop cycle; it is not profit, nutrition or evidence of buyer demand.
english: Yield points use the conservative end of published commercial KZN benchmarks where that crop is listed. They compare plans; they do not predict this household's harvest. The warm/light-frost windows, spacing and duration use the official tables where those tables cover the crop; catalog fallbacks and other regional patterns still need local confirmation. Bed occupancy uses the upper published maturity/picking endpoint so two crops are not booked onto the same ground, but the source says these times are approximate and assume optimum conditions; actual crops may mature later. Every later sowing or transplant is conditional on observing that the previous crop is finished and the bed is clear. The app does not split a crop-cycle total into invented monthly kilograms. Auto-suggest only ranks crops with verified yield, duration and field-spacing support. A family plan starts from a supported diverse mix; an exact crop list becomes a strict whitelist. It requires irrigation because intensive succession without a farm water plan is not defensible. Its packing is a transparent heuristic, not proof of a global maximum or of a physical row layout. Commercial ranking is fresh weight per crop cycle; it is not profit, nutrition or evidence of buyer demand.
draft: Opbrengspunte gebruik die konserwatiewe kant van gepubliseerde kommersiële KZN-maatstawwe waar daardie gewas gelys is. Hulle vergelyk planne; hulle voorspel nie hierdie huishouding se oes nie. Die vensters vir warm gebiede/ligte ryp, spasiëring en tydsduur gebruik die amptelike tabelle waar daardie tabelle die gewas dek; katalogus-terugvalle en ander streekspatrone het steeds plaaslike bevestiging nodig. Beddingbesetting gebruik die boonste gepubliseerde volwassenheids-/plukeindpunt sodat twee gewasse nie op dieselfde grond bespreek word nie, maar die bron sê hierdie tye is benaderd en aanvaar optimale toestande; werklike gewasse kan later volwasse word. Elke latere saaiery of oorplanting hang daarvan af dat daar waargeneem word dat die vorige gewas klaar is en die bedding skoon is. Die app verdeel nie 'n gewassiklustotaal in uitgedinkte maandelikse kilogram nie. Outo-voorstel rangskik slegs gewasse met geverifieerde ondersteuning vir opbrengs, tydsduur en veldspasiëring. 'n Gesinsplan begin vanaf 'n gestaafde diverse mengsel; 'n presiese gewaslys word 'n streng witlys. Dit vereis besproeiing, omdat intensiewe opvolging sonder 'n plaaswaterplan nie verdedigbaar is nie. Die inpakking daarvan is 'n deursigtige heuristiek, nie bewys van 'n globale maksimum of van 'n fisiese ry-uitleg nie. Kommersiële rangorde is varsgewig per gewassiklus; dit is nie wins, voeding of bewys van kopersvraag nie.

english: Look at the displayed sun, wind, fire and water information. Read the source and missing-data notes. Some information is modelled or regional context, rather than a measurement on your land.

english: Keep the measured evidence unchanged. Correct the drawing to reflect the intended design; do not rewrite measurements to conceal an accidental edit.

english: Use Back to design to correct mapped growing areas. Do not change a crop quantity merely to hide an incorrect bed size. Keep practice or unmapped areas separate from a measured farm plan.

english: Enter the variety from your seed packet if you know it. Leave it blank if you do not. An entered variety name does not turn general crop guidance into a verified variety-specific schedule.

english: Read overlap and unverified-timing messages. A warning is a reason to review the plan, even when the screen still lets you save. Do not assume two crop bars mean both fit.

english: The plan saves on this device as you work. Read any Not saving warning and keep a copy while resolving it. A closed editor does not prove a cloud backup exists.

english: Suggest a plan prepares a proposal. Review its crops, timing, area shares and unresolved notes before choosing Add plantings to my plan. It adds around existing plantings; it does not erase them. Do not use Clear all simply to try a suggestion.

english: Weigh produce sold in bunches or crates before entering kilograms. Do not invent a conversion or enter the number of bunches as its weight.

english: More sold than picked can mean a missing harvest record or a sale from an earlier harvest. Investigate the dates and records; do not change a weight just to make the chart look tidy.

english: Zero would say there was no weight. An unknown weight must not be turned into zero.

english: If a recorded sale has no invoice, use Create invoice on that sale when available. Keep its recorded crop, kilograms, amount and payment date. Do not start another sale to create its paperwork.

english: A deposit or instalment is not payment in full. This app does not keep a partial-payment balance schedule. Keep a separate checked record of amounts received and still owed; do not mark the invoice fully paid for a deposit.

english: For a paid invoice, check the amount in Sold and reopen its invoice link. Do not manually add its income again because a linked crop record also exists.

key: Yes. Link the R40.00 evidence to the invoice and keep R80.00 outstanding in a checked supporting record. Do not create a second produce sale.
english: Yes. Link the R40.00 evidence to the invoice and keep R80.00 outstanding in a checked supporting record. Do not create a second produce sale.

english: Look for the cost in Spent first. If it already exists, use Edit on that row to correct it. Do not add another copy of the same payment.

key: Invoices are saved on this device. Do not assume the complete document is available on another device because a linked sale has synchronised. Keep the source record and a checked copy.
english: Invoices are saved on this device. Do not assume the complete document is available on another device because a linked sale has synchronised. Keep the source record and a checked copy.
draft: Fakture word op hierdie toestel gestoor. Moenie aanneem dat die volledige dokument op 'n ander toestel beskikbaar is omdat 'n gekoppelde verkoping gesinkroniseer het nie. Hou die bronrekord en 'n nagegaande kopie.

key: Bring the original reference, issue date, buyer, goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. Check whether payment arrived and on which date. Do not guess missing details.
english: Bring the original reference, issue date, buyer, goods, quantities, units and agreed prices. Check whether payment arrived and on which date. Do not guess missing details.
draft: Bring die oorspronklike verwysing, uitreikdatum, koper, goedere, hoeveelhede, eenhede en ooreengekome pryse. Kontroleer of betaling opgedaag het en op watter datum. Moenie ontbrekende besonderhede raai nie.

key: If an invoice already exists, reopen it from Saved or its View link. Do not create a new sale because the buyer wants another copy.
english: If an invoice already exists, reopen it from Saved or its View link. Do not create a new sale because the buyer wants another copy.
draft: As 'n faktuur reeds bestaan, maak dit weer oop vanuit Gestoor of sy Bekyk-skakel. Moenie 'n nuwe verkoping skep omdat die koper nog 'n afskrif wil hê nie.

key: An empty list is not proof that the sale never happened. It may already have an invoice or may not be an eligible kilogram record. Check Saved and your original evidence. Never pick a similar sale as a substitute.
english: An empty list is not proof that the sale never happened. It may already have an invoice or may not be an eligible kilogram record. Check Saved and your original evidence. Never pick a similar sale as a substitute.
draft: 'n Leë lys is nie bewys dat die verkoping nooit gebeur het nie. Dit het dalk reeds 'n faktuur of is dalk nie 'n geskikte kilogramrekord nie. Kontroleer Gestoor en jou oorspronklike bewyse. Kies nooit 'n soortgelyke verkoping as plaasvervanger nie.

key: Bunches, bags and kilograms are different units. Keep the unit on the source. Do not invent a weight to make an old record fit.
english: Bunches, bags and kilograms are different units. Keep the unit on the source. Do not invent a weight to make an old record fit.
draft: Bossies, sakke en kilogram is verskillende eenhede. Hou die eenheid op die bron. Moenie 'n gewig versin om 'n ou rekord te laat pas nie.

key: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment remains due. This app does not keep an instalment ledger. Keep deposits and the remaining balance separately; do not mark a deposit as full payment.
english: Choose Not yet — payment outstanding when payment remains due. This app does not keep an instalment ledger. Keep deposits and the remaining balance separately; do not mark a deposit as full payment.
draft: Kies Nog nie — betaling uitstaande wanneer betaling steeds verskuldig is. Hierdie app hou nie 'n paaiementgrootboek nie. Hou deposito's en die oorblywende saldo afsonderlik; moenie 'n deposito as volle betaling merk nie.

key: A saved invoice’s issue date is locked. Check it before saving; keep the original evidence and seek help with that record if it is wrong. Do not add another sale as a correction.
english: A saved invoice’s issue date is locked. Check it before saving; keep the original evidence and seek help with that record if it is wrong. Do not add another sale as a correction.
draft: 'n Gestoorde faktuur se uitreikdatum is gesluit. Kontroleer dit voordat jy stoor; hou die oorspronklike bewyse en soek hulp met daardie rekord as dit verkeerd is. Moenie nog 'n verkoping as regstelling byvoeg nie.

key: Practise in the sample tour. Keep real banking and customer details private. A practice export ends with checking the copy; do not send it to a real customer.
english: Practise in the sample tour. Keep real banking and customer details private. A practice export ends with checking the copy; do not send it to a real customer.
draft: Oefen in die voorbeeldtoer. Hou werklike bank- en kliëntbesonderhede privaat. 'n Oefenuitvoer eindig met die nagaan van die afskrif; moenie dit na 'n werklike kliënt stuur nie.

key: Check that you are editing that invoice. Do not start New invoice to record payment for goods already invoiced.
english: Check that you are editing that invoice. Do not start New invoice to record payment for goods already invoiced.
draft: Kontroleer dat jy daardie faktuur wysig. Moenie Nuwe faktuur begin om betaling aan te teken vir goedere wat reeds gefaktureer is nie.

key: This screen supports paid in full or unpaid. For a deposit or instalment, keep the amounts, dates and balance in a separate supporting record. Do not mark the whole invoice paid.
english: This screen supports paid in full or unpaid. For a deposit or instalment, keep the amounts, dates and balance in a separate supporting record. Do not mark the whole invoice paid.
draft: Hierdie skerm ondersteun ten volle betaal of onbetaal. Vir 'n deposito of paaiement, hou die bedrae, datums en saldo in 'n afsonderlike ondersteunende rekord. Moenie die hele faktuur as betaal merk nie.

key: Check the related invoice and amount in Sold. Paid invoice income is included in the money book. Do not enter another quick sale for the same payment.
english: Check the related invoice and amount in Sold. Paid invoice income is included in the money book. Do not enter another quick sale for the same payment.
draft: Kontroleer die verwante faktuur en bedrag in Verkoop. Inkomste van betaalde fakture is by die geldboek ingesluit. Moenie nog 'n vinnige verkoping vir dieselfde betaling invoer nie.

key: Correct. The app has no instalment ledger. Keep the evidence separately and do not mark full payment until it is supported.
english: Correct. The app has no instalment ledger. Keep the evidence separately and do not mark full payment until it is supported.
draft: Korrek. Die app het geen paaiementgrootboek nie. Hou die bewyse afsonderlik en moenie volle betaling merk totdat dit ondersteun word nie.

key: Independent practice: reopen one paid and one unpaid sample invoice. Explain the date and status on each, then identify the document and recipient you would check before sharing. Do not send the examples.
english: Independent practice: reopen one paid and one unpaid sample invoice. Explain the date and status on each, then identify the document and recipient you would check before sharing. Do not send the examples.
draft: Onafhanklike oefening: maak een betaalde en een onbetaalde voorbeeldfaktuur weer oop. Verduidelik die datum en status op elkeen, en identifiseer dan die dokument en ontvanger wat jy sou nagaan voordat jy deel. Moenie die voorbeelde stuur nie.

key: Cash surplus and Recorded cash margin describe the included records. Missing expenses, stock, equipment treatment, debt and other accounts can change the complete business result. Do not call one chart a full profit-and-loss statement.
english: Cash surplus and Recorded cash margin describe the included records. Missing expenses, stock, equipment treatment, debt and other accounts can change the complete business result. Do not call one chart a full profit-and-loss statement.
draft: Kontantoorskot en Aangetekende kontantmarge beskryf die ingesluite rekords. Ontbrekende uitgawes, voorraad, hantering van toerusting, skuld en ander rekeninge kan die volledige besigheidsresultaat verander. Moenie een grafiek 'n volledige wins-en-verliesstaat noem nie.

key: A dashed outline can mark a month with more sold than logged as picked. Read the explanation and check missing harvests or sales from earlier stock. Do not enter an invented harvest to make the bars agree.
english: A dashed outline can mark a month with more sold than logged as picked. Read the explanation and check missing harvests or sales from earlier stock. Do not enter an invented harvest to make the bars agree.
draft: 'n Stippelbuitelyn kan 'n maand merk met meer verkoop as wat as gepluk aangeteken is. Lees die verduideliking en kontroleer vir ontbrekende oeste of verkope uit vroeër voorraad. Moenie 'n versinde oes invoer om die stawe te laat ooreenstem nie.

key: Harvest and cost logging forms stamp the entry date. Paid invoices use their recorded payment date. Check the actual source dates and keep late-entry evidence; do not assume every chart month is the date work happened.
english: Harvest and cost logging forms stamp the entry date. Paid invoices use their recorded payment date. Check the actual source dates and keep late-entry evidence; do not assume every chart month is the date work happened.
draft: Vorms vir die aanteken van oeste en koste stempel die inskrywingsdatum. Betaalde fakture gebruik hul aangetekende betaaldatum. Kontroleer die werklike brondatums en hou bewyse van laat inskrywings; moenie aanneem dat elke grafiekmaand die datum is waarop werk gebeur het nie.

key: A paid invoice has one payment date for its whole amount. The app cannot show a full instalment history from that field. Keep separate evidence for part payments and do not mark a deposit as full payment.
english: A paid invoice has one payment date for its whole amount. The app cannot show a full instalment history from that field. Keep separate evidence for part payments and do not mark a deposit as full payment.
draft: 'n Betaalde faktuur het een betaaldatum vir sy hele bedrag. Die app kan nie 'n volledige paaiementgeskiedenis uit daardie veld wys nie. Hou afsonderlike bewyse vir gedeeltelike betalings en moenie 'n deposito as volle betaling merk nie.

key: Do not invent a sale to change a chart. Investigate the period, missing records and original evidence.
english: Do not invent a sale to change a chart. Investigate the period, missing records and original evidence.
draft: Moenie 'n verkoping versin om 'n grafiek te verander nie. Ondersoek die tydperk, ontbrekende rekords en oorspronklike bewyse.

key: Practise with the sample tour. Its figures belong to an example farm. Keep practice files separate from your own records and do not send them to a lender or customer.
english: Practise with the sample tour. Its figures belong to an example farm. Keep practice files separate from your own records and do not send them to a lender or customer.
draft: Oefen met die voorbeeldtoer. Sy syfers behoort aan 'n voorbeeldplaas. Hou oefenlêers afsonderlik van jou eie rekords en moenie dit na 'n lener of kliënt stuur nie.

key: On a phone or compact screen, Export this month (CSV) exports the current calendar month. The chart’s 6m, 12m and 24m buttons do not change that export. Use the wide Financial sheet when you need its other periods.
english: On a phone or compact screen, Export this month (CSV) exports the current calendar month. The chart’s 6m, 12m and 24m buttons do not change that export. Use the wide Financial sheet when you need its other periods.
draft: Op 'n foon of kompakte skerm voer Voer hierdie maand uit (CSV) die huidige kalendermaand uit. Die grafiek se 6m-, 12m- en 24m-knoppies verander nie daardie uitvoer nie. Gebruik die breë Finansiële staat wanneer jy sy ander tydperke nodig het.

key: Read any Check warning before adding totals. A possible duplicate needs investigation against its source. If there are no rows, check the period and saved records before concluding that nothing happened.
english: Read any Check warning before adding totals. A possible duplicate needs investigation against its source. If there are no rows, check the period and saved records before concluding that nothing happened.
draft: Lees enige Check-waarskuwing voordat jy totale optel. 'n Moontlike duplikaat moet teen sy bron ondersoek word. As daar geen rye is nie, kontroleer die tydperk en gestoorde rekords voordat jy besluit dat niks gebeur het nie.

key: You can trace a row, explain its date and units, and identify any warning.
english: You can trace a row, explain its date and units, and identify any warning.
draft: Jy kan 'n ry naspeur, sy datum en eenhede verduidelik en enige waarskuwing identifiseer.

key: For this practice, stop with your checked sample copy. Explain its limits; do not submit example records as your own.
english: For this practice, stop with your checked sample copy. Explain its limits; do not submit example records as your own.
draft: Stop vir hierdie oefening by jou nagegaande voorbeeldkopie. Verduidelik sy beperkings; moenie voorbeeldrekords as jou eie indien nie.

key: The exports summarise entered records. They do not verify payment, certify complete accounts or establish eligibility for finance. Keep the evidence and unresolved questions available for the person helping you.
english: The exports summarise entered records. They do not verify payment, certify complete accounts or establish eligibility for finance. Keep the evidence and unresolved questions available for the person helping you.
draft: Die uitvoere som ingevoerde rekords op. Hulle verifieer nie betaling nie, sertifiseer nie volledige rekeninge nie en bewys nie geskiktheid vir finansiering nie. Hou die bewyse en onopgeloste vrae beskikbaar vir die persoon wat jou help.

key: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Turn site evidence into a report. Its pictures, household interview and soil values are examples. Do not use them as evidence about your own land.
english: For practice, open the sample tour and choose Turn site evidence into a report. Its pictures, household interview and soil values are examples. Do not use them as evidence about your own land.
draft: Om te oefen, maak die voorbeeldtoer oop en kies Verander terreinbewyse in 'n verslag. Sy foto's, huishoudingsonderhoud en grondwaardes is voorbeelde. Moenie dit as bewyse oor jou eie grond gebruik nie.

key: Review the site and household survey. Write what was observed or reported, and identify what you still need to check. Do not invent an answer to fill a gap.
english: Review the site and household survey. Write what was observed or reported, and identify what you still need to check. Do not invent an answer to fill a gap.
draft: Hersien die terrein- en huishoudingsopname. Skryf neer wat waargeneem of gerapporteer is, en identifiseer wat jy nog moet nagaan. Moenie 'n antwoord versin om 'n gaping te vul nie.

key: Use the sample tour for practice. Its progress is disposable. Do not keep your real course evidence in the sample workspace. Ask your facilitator which module and practical task to work on.
english: Use the sample tour for practice. Its progress is disposable. Do not keep your real course evidence in the sample workspace. Ask your facilitator which module and practical task to work on.
draft: Gebruik die voorbeeldtoer om te oefen. Sy vordering is weggooibaar. Moenie jou werklike kursusbewyse in die voorbeeldwerkruimte hou nie. Vra jou fasiliteerder aan watter module en praktiese taak jy moet werk.

key:
A brief says what the design should help people do. Begin by listening. Ask who uses the place, what is already working and what is difficult. Ask about food, movement, care work and what people want to protect. People may value privacy, a familiar gathering place or a clear route as much as another growing area.

Include the people who do the work. Do not ask only the person who speaks first. A proposal that relies on another person's daily labour needs their agreement. Ask what happens when the usual carer is away. Keep private household information out of a public course example.

Separate a need from an idea. “We need a reliable way to water the existing garden” states a need. “We need a new tank” suggests one possible response. The response still needs information about supply, demand, location, cost and care. Drawing it does not answer those questions.

Write the priorities in plain language, or record them with consent as an oral explanation. Say what is outside this first phase. Record available resources as known, reported or still unknown. Read the brief back to the household and invite corrections. Disagreement is useful information; do not hide it to finish the sheet.
english:
A brief says what the design should help people do. Begin by listening. Ask who uses the place, what is already working and what is difficult. Ask about food, movement, care work and what people want to protect. People may value privacy, a familiar gathering place or a clear route as much as another growing area.

Include the people who do the work. Do not ask only the person who speaks first. A proposal that relies on another person's daily labour needs their agreement. Ask what happens when the usual carer is away. Keep private household information out of a public course example.

Separate a need from an idea. “We need a reliable way to water the existing garden” states a need. “We need a new tank” suggests one possible response. The response still needs information about supply, demand, location, cost and care. Drawing it does not answer those questions.

Write the priorities in plain language, or record them with consent as an oral explanation. Say what is outside this first phase. Record available resources as known, reported or still unknown. Read the brief back to the household and invite corrections. Disagreement is useful information; do not hide it to finish the sheet.
draft:
'n Opdrag sê waarmee die ontwerp mense moet help. Begin deur te luister. Vra wie die plek gebruik, wat reeds werk en wat moeilik is. Vra oor kos, beweging, versorgingswerk en wat mense wil beskerm. Mense kan privaatheid, 'n bekende byeenkomsplek of 'n duidelike roete net soveel waardeer as nog 'n groeiarea.

Sluit die mense in wat die werk doen. Moenie net die persoon vra wat eerste praat nie. 'n Voorstel wat op 'n ander persoon se daaglikse arbeid staatmaak, het hul instemming nodig. Vra wat gebeur wanneer die gewone versorger weg is. Hou private huishoudingsinligting uit 'n openbare kursusvoorbeeld.

Skei 'n behoefte van 'n idee. “Ons het 'n betroubare manier nodig om die bestaande tuin nat te lei” stel 'n behoefte. “Ons het 'n nuwe tenk nodig” stel een moontlike reaksie voor. Die reaksie het steeds inligting nodig oor aanbod, vraag, ligging, koste en versorging. Om dit te teken, beantwoord nie daardie vrae nie.

Skryf die prioriteite in eenvoudige taal, of teken dit met toestemming as 'n mondelinge verduideliking op. Sê wat buite hierdie eerste fase val. Teken beskikbare hulpbronne aan as bekend, gerapporteer of nog onbekend. Lees die opdrag terug aan die huishouding en nooi regstellings uit. Onenigheid is nuttige inligting; moenie dit verberg om die blad klaar te maak nie.

key: Getting started and evidence guides. A paper brief is valid; do not put private household details into a public sample.
english: Getting started and evidence guides. A paper brief is valid; do not put private household details into a public sample.
draft: Gidse om te begin en oor bewyse. 'n Papieropdrag is geldig; moenie private huishoudingsbesonderhede in 'n openbare voorbeeld sit nie.

key:
Observation starts with what is there. Walk safely with someone who knows the place. Look at routes, water points, ground cover, shade, buildings, growing areas and signs of past use. Listen to the people who use the site. A short visit and a long memory offer different evidence.

Keep those differences visible. “I saw this” is an observation. “The resident described this” is a report. “I measured this” needs the method and unit. “I think this may happen” is an interpretation. “I want to put this here” is a proposal. All can be useful, but they are not interchangeable.

Record when and under what conditions you observed. A shaded patch during one visit is not a full seasonal sunlight record. A dry water point on one day does not by itself explain the cause or the whole year's supply. Look again when it is safe and useful. Do not wait for perfect knowledge before keeping a record, and do not pretend a short visit supplies it.

Use a notebook, labelled drawing or consented photograph. Give each piece of evidence a short reference you can put on the map. If a plant, pipe or boundary is uncertain, label the uncertainty. Do not identify a plant or underground service from an attractive illustration.
english:
Observation starts with what is there. Walk safely with someone who knows the place. Look at routes, water points, ground cover, shade, buildings, growing areas and signs of past use. Listen to the people who use the site. A short visit and a long memory offer different evidence.

Keep those differences visible. “I saw this” is an observation. “The resident described this” is a report. “I measured this” needs the method and unit. “I think this may happen” is an interpretation. “I want to put this here” is a proposal. All can be useful, but they are not interchangeable.

Record when and under what conditions you observed. A shaded patch during one visit is not a full seasonal sunlight record. A dry water point on one day does not by itself explain the cause or the whole year's supply. Look again when it is safe and useful. Do not wait for perfect knowledge before keeping a record, and do not pretend a short visit supplies it.

Use a notebook, labelled drawing or consented photograph. Give each piece of evidence a short reference you can put on the map. If a plant, pipe or boundary is uncertain, label the uncertainty. Do not identify a plant or underground service from an attractive illustration.
draft:
Waarneming begin met wat daar is. Loop veilig saam met iemand wat die plek ken. Kyk na roetes, waterpunte, grondbedekking, skadu, geboue, groeiareas en tekens van vorige gebruik. Luister na die mense wat die terrein gebruik. 'n Kort besoek en 'n lang geheue bied verskillende bewyse.

Hou daardie verskille sigbaar. “Ek het dit gesien” is 'n waarneming. “Die inwoner het dit beskryf” is 'n verslag. “Ek het dit gemeet” het die metode en eenheid nodig. “Ek dink dit kan gebeur” is 'n interpretasie. “Ek wil dit hier sit” is 'n voorstel. Almal kan nuttig wees, maar hulle is nie uitruilbaar nie.

Teken aan wanneer en onder watter toestande jy waargeneem het. 'n Skaduryke kol tydens een besoek is nie 'n volledige seisoenale sonligrekord nie. 'n Droë waterpunt op een dag verklaar nie op sy eie die oorsaak of die hele jaar se voorsiening nie. Kyk weer wanneer dit veilig en nuttig is. Moenie vir volmaakte kennis wag voordat jy 'n rekord hou nie, en moenie voorgee dat 'n kort besoek dit verskaf nie.

Gebruik 'n notaboek, 'n gemerkte tekening of 'n foto met toestemming. Gee elke stuk bewyse 'n kort verwysing wat jy op die kaart kan sit. As 'n plant, pyp of grens onseker is, merk die onsekerheid. Moenie 'n plant of ondergrondse diens uit 'n aantreklike illustrasie identifiseer nie.

key: WALK-A records the route and carried containers as seen. TALK-A records the resident's rain account as reported. The learner does not turn that account into a measured contour or flood depth. Further investigation becomes an action in the evidence register.
english: WALK-A records the route and carried containers as seen. TALK-A records the resident's rain account as reported. The learner does not turn that account into a measured contour or flood depth. Further investigation becomes an action in the evidence register.
draft: WALK-A teken die roete en die houers wat gedra word aan soos gesien. TALK-A teken die inwoner se verhaal oor die reën aan soos gerapporteer. Die leerder verander nie daardie verhaal in 'n gemete kontoer of vloeddiepte nie. Verdere ondersoek word 'n aksie in die bewysregister.

key: The learner distinguishes observed, reported, measured, inferred and proposed information, and names a useful next check. More photographs do not automatically mean better evidence.
english: The learner distinguishes observed, reported, measured, inferred and proposed information, and names a useful next check. More photographs do not automatically mean better evidence.
draft: Die leerder onderskei waargeneemde, gerapporteerde, gemete, afgeleide en voorgestelde inligting, en noem 'n nuttige volgende kontrole. Meer foto's beteken nie outomaties beter bewyse nie.

key:
A base map shows the place before the proposed changes. It helps everyone discuss the same site. Show the existing buildings, access routes, water points, growing areas and other features that matter to the brief. Mark north when you have checked it, and keep the source of the boundary visible.

A first sketch may help you understand relationships. Label it “not to scale” if that is what it is. Before using a plan to judge fit, check the measurements and use a consistent scale. Keep units with dimensions. Measure relevant widths and distances safely, and record whether a value was measured, taken from a source or estimated. A precise-looking line is not proof of a precise measurement.

Keep the existing map and the proposal separate. A transparent sheet over paper, a saved copy or a clearly labelled proposal layer lets you try ideas while preserving what is actually there. Do not silently shift the house, path or boundary to make an idea fit. A traced satellite picture can be a starting reference; it does not by itself establish legal ownership or a surveyed boundary.

Give the map a title, date or revision, legend and source notes. Use words as well as colour so a printed or colour-blind reader can distinguish existing features, proposed changes and uncertain information. Leave enough space for labels to be read.
english:
A base map shows the place before the proposed changes. It helps everyone discuss the same site. Show the existing buildings, access routes, water points, growing areas and other features that matter to the brief. Mark north when you have checked it, and keep the source of the boundary visible.

A first sketch may help you understand relationships. Label it “not to scale” if that is what it is. Before using a plan to judge fit, check the measurements and use a consistent scale. Keep units with dimensions. Measure relevant widths and distances safely, and record whether a value was measured, taken from a source or estimated. A precise-looking line is not proof of a precise measurement.

Keep the existing map and the proposal separate. A transparent sheet over paper, a saved copy or a clearly labelled proposal layer lets you try ideas while preserving what is actually there. Do not silently shift the house, path or boundary to make an idea fit. A traced satellite picture can be a starting reference; it does not by itself establish legal ownership or a surveyed boundary.

Give the map a title, date or revision, legend and source notes. Use words as well as colour so a printed or colour-blind reader can distinguish existing features, proposed changes and uncertain information. Leave enough space for labels to be read.
draft:
'n Basiskaart wys die plek voor die voorgestelde veranderinge. Dit help almal om dieselfde terrein te bespreek. Wys die bestaande geboue, toegangsroetes, waterpunte, groeiareas en ander kenmerke wat vir die opdrag saak maak. Merk noord wanneer jy dit nagegaan het, en hou die bron van die grens sigbaar.

'n Eerste skets kan jou help om verhoudings te verstaan. Merk dit “nie volgens skaal nie” as dit is wat dit is. Voordat jy 'n plan gebruik om te beoordeel of iets pas, kontroleer die metings en gebruik 'n konsekwente skaal. Hou eenhede by afmetings. Meet tersaaklike breedtes en afstande veilig, en teken aan of 'n waarde gemeet, uit 'n bron geneem of geskat is. 'n Lyn wat presies lyk, is nie bewys van 'n presiese meting nie.

Hou die bestaande kaart en die voorstel afsonderlik. 'n Deursigtige vel oor papier, 'n gestoorde kopie of 'n duidelik gemerkte voorstellaag laat jou idees probeer terwyl jy bewaar wat werklik daar is. Moenie die huis, paadjie of grens stilweg skuif om 'n idee te laat pas nie. 'n Nagetrekte satellietfoto kan 'n beginverwysing wees; dit bewys nie op sy eie wettige eienaarskap of 'n opgemete grens nie.

Gee die kaart 'n titel, datum of hersiening, sleutel en bronnotas. Gebruik woorde sowel as kleur sodat 'n gedrukte of kleurblinde leser bestaande kenmerke, voorgestelde veranderinge en onseker inligting kan onderskei. Laat genoeg spasie sodat etikette gelees kan word.

key:
Zone planning considers how people use and care for things. Something needing frequent attention should be considered in relation to the routes people already take. Look at the actual work: visiting, watering, harvesting, feeding, carrying and checking. A short distance on paper may still be awkward if there is a steep step, a locked gate or an obstructed path.

Zones are a thinking tool, not compulsory rings. A small site does not need to contain every zone. Do not assign a fixed zone to every animal or crop without considering its care and the household. The placement must also suit the element's other needs.

Sector analysis considers influences such as sun, wind, incoming water and neighbouring activities. Use the evidence for this site. Label a direction as observed, reported or still needing confirmation. A regional description is not proof that the wind at this particular home always comes from one direction.

Put the layers beside each other. Convenience may suggest a place near the home; shade, access or other constraints may make that place unsuitable. This is a question to resolve, not a reason to ignore one of the layers. Explain both the benefit and the limitation of a proposed position.
english:
Zone planning considers how people use and care for things. Something needing frequent attention should be considered in relation to the routes people already take. Look at the actual work: visiting, watering, harvesting, feeding, carrying and checking. A short distance on paper may still be awkward if there is a steep step, a locked gate or an obstructed path.

Zones are a thinking tool, not compulsory rings. A small site does not need to contain every zone. Do not assign a fixed zone to every animal or crop without considering its care and the household. The placement must also suit the element's other needs.

Sector analysis considers influences such as sun, wind, incoming water and neighbouring activities. Use the evidence for this site. Label a direction as observed, reported or still needing confirmation. A regional description is not proof that the wind at this particular home always comes from one direction.

Put the layers beside each other. Convenience may suggest a place near the home; shade, access or other constraints may make that place unsuitable. This is a question to resolve, not a reason to ignore one of the layers. Explain both the benefit and the limitation of a proposed position.
draft:
Sonebeplanning oorweeg hoe mense dinge gebruik en versorg. Iets wat gereelde aandag nodig het, moet oorweeg word in verhouding tot die roetes wat mense reeds loop. Kyk na die werklike werk: besoek, natlei, oes, voer, dra en nagaan. 'n Kort afstand op papier kan steeds lastig wees as daar 'n steil trap, 'n geslote hek of 'n versperde paadjie is.

Sones is 'n denkhulpmiddel, nie verpligte ringe nie. 'n Klein terrein hoef nie elke sone te bevat nie. Moenie 'n vaste sone aan elke dier of gewas toeken sonder om sy versorging en die huishouding te oorweeg nie. Die plasing moet ook by die element se ander behoeftes pas.

Sektorontleding oorweeg invloede soos son, wind, inkomende water en bure se aktiwiteite. Gebruik die bewyse vir hierdie terrein. Merk 'n rigting as waargeneem, gerapporteer of nog te bevestig. 'n Streeksbeskrywing is nie bewys dat die wind by hierdie spesifieke huis altyd uit een rigting kom nie.

Sit die lae langs mekaar. Gerief kan 'n plek naby die huis voorstel; skadu, toegang of ander beperkings kan daardie plek ongeskik maak. Dit is 'n vraag om op te los, nie 'n rede om een van die lae te ignoreer nie. Verduidelik sowel die voordeel as die beperking van 'n voorgestelde posisie.

key:
A design brings different observations together. Trace how people reach the places they use, where water is observed or reported, and where shade changes. Consider how the same arrangement might work in different conditions. Keep a useful access route in view while thinking about a new growing area.

The position of a water point does not tell you how much suitable water is reliably available. A tank drawn higher on a map is not necessarily higher on the ground. A flow arrow does not supply levels, soil information, a safe outlet or permission to redirect water. Those questions need appropriate evidence and, where relevant, qualified help. Keep drainage and construction proposals separate from what is already known.

A photograph of a green site does not prove year-round supply. Ask what changes during dry periods, rain, cold or household absence. Use local records and the existing seasonal-planning lessons to decide what else to observe. Do not copy a calendar or a fixed compass rule from another place without checking its relevance.

Some constraints change the scope of a proposal. If water, access or care is unresolved, improving a smaller existing area may be worth comparing with expansion. Deferring a feature can be a sound design decision. Explain the missing evidence and the next action so “later” does not mean forgotten.

A flow arrow does not supply levels, soil information, a safe outlet or permission to redirect water. Those questions need appropriate evidence and, where relevant, qualified help. Use local records and the existing seasonal-planning lessons to decide what else to observe. Do not copy a calendar or a fixed compass rule from another place without checking its relevance.

Some constraints change the scope of a proposal. If water, access or care is unresolved, improving a smaller existing area may be worth comparing with expansion. Deferring a feature can be a sound design decision. Explain the missing evidence and the next action so “later” does not mean forgotten.
draft:
'n Ontwerp bring verskillende waarnemings saam. Volg hoe mense die plekke bereik wat hulle gebruik, waar water waargeneem of gerapporteer word, en waar skadu verander. Oorweeg hoe dieselfde rangskikking in verskillende toestande kan werk. Hou 'n nuttige toegangsroete in gedagte terwyl jy aan 'n nuwe groeiarea dink.

Die posisie van 'n waterpunt sê nie vir jou hoeveel geskikte water betroubaar beskikbaar is nie. 'n Tenk wat hoër op 'n kaart geteken is, is nie noodwendig hoër op die grond nie. 'n Vloeipyl verskaf nie vlakke, grondinligting, 'n veilige uitlaat of toestemming om water om te lei nie. Daardie vrae het gepaste bewyse nodig en, waar tersaaklik, gekwalifiseerde hulp. Hou dreinerings- en konstruksievoorstelle afsonderlik van wat reeds bekend is.

'n Foto van 'n groen terrein bewys nie voorsiening die hele jaar deur nie. Vra wat verander tydens droë tydperke, reën, koue of wanneer die huishouding afwesig is. Gebruik plaaslike rekords en die bestaande lesse oor seisoenale beplanning om te besluit wat nog waargeneem moet word. Moenie 'n kalender of 'n vaste kompasreël van 'n ander plek kopieer sonder om die toepaslikheid daarvan na te gaan nie.

Sommige beperkings verander die omvang van 'n voorstel. As water, toegang of versorging onopgelos is, kan dit die moeite werd wees om die verbetering van 'n kleiner bestaande area met uitbreiding te vergelyk. Om 'n kenmerk uit te stel, kan 'n gesonde ontwerpbesluit wees. Verduidelik die ontbrekende bewyse en die volgende aksie sodat “later” nie vergete beteken nie.

key: The busy-yard learner keeps the used route clear on every concept. They mark the eastern water report for further investigation rather than drawing a trench. They ask about the reliability and suitability of the existing supply before promising a larger garden.
english: The busy-yard learner keeps the used route clear on every concept. They mark the eastern water report for further investigation rather than drawing a trench. They ask about the reliability and suitability of the existing supply before promising a larger garden.
draft: Die leerder in die besige-werf-geval hou die gebruikte roete oop in elke konsep. Hulle merk die waterverslag in die ooste vir verdere ondersoek eerder as om 'n sloot te teken. Hulle vra oor die betroubaarheid en geskiktheid van die bestaande voorsiening voordat hulle 'n groter tuin belowe.

key: Does drawing a swale settle whether it is suitable or safe to build?
english: Does drawing a swale settle whether it is suitable or safe to build?
draft: Bepaal die teken van 'n kontoersloot of dit geskik of veilig is om te bou?

key: Mapping, design and crop-planning guides. Keep a proposed water feature labelled as proposed; do not mistake software availability for site suitability.
english: Mapping, design and crop-planning guides. Keep a proposed water feature labelled as proposed; do not mistake software availability for site suitability.
draft: Karterings-, ontwerp- en gewasbeplanningsgidse. Hou 'n voorgestelde waterkenmerk as voorgestel gemerk; moenie die beskikbaarheid daarvan in sagteware met terreingeskiktheid verwar nie.

key:
Analysis turns the brief and evidence into questions that can guide a design. For each important observation, explain why it matters to the household. Then identify a possible response and what would need to be true for that response to work.

Keep the chain visible: need, evidence, implication, possible response, missing check. If a step is missing, return to it. A learner may notice that a route is used frequently, but still need to ask who uses it and what they carry before changing its shape.

Use the ethics in a practical way. Who gains from a proposal? Who takes on more work? What existing life, soil, water or shared resource could be harmed? A benefit for one element may create a problem elsewhere. Do not call a system sustainable simply because it has many features or recycles something.

Write criteria before choosing your favourite drawing. Criteria come from the brief and site evidence: access remains usable, care is agreed, water needs can be met, and important unknowns are resolved or the affected work is deferred. A criterion needs evidence. “Looks natural” alone does not demonstrate that the household can maintain it.
english:
