Write criteria before choosing your favourite drawing. Criteria come from the brief and site evidence: access remains usable, care is agreed, water needs can be met, and important unknowns are resolved or the affected work is deferred. A criterion needs evidence. “Looks natural” alone does not demonstrate that the household can maintain it.
draft:
Ontleding verander die opdrag en bewyse in vrae wat 'n ontwerp kan rig. Verduidelik vir elke belangrike waarneming waarom dit vir die huishouding saak maak. Identifiseer dan 'n moontlike reaksie en wat waar sou moet wees vir daardie reaksie om te werk.

Hou die ketting sigbaar: behoefte, bewyse, implikasie, moontlike reaksie, ontbrekende kontrole. As 'n stap ontbreek, gaan terug daarna. 'n Leerder kan opmerk dat 'n roete gereeld gebruik word, maar moet steeds vra wie dit gebruik en wat hulle dra voordat die vorm daarvan verander word.

Gebruik die etiek op 'n praktiese manier. Wie trek voordeel uit 'n voorstel? Wie neem meer werk op hom? Watter bestaande lewe, grond, water of gedeelde hulpbron kan skade ly? 'n Voordeel vir een element kan elders 'n probleem skep. Moenie 'n stelsel volhoubaar noem net omdat dit baie kenmerke het of iets herwin nie.

Skryf kriteria neer voordat jy jou gunstelingtekening kies. Kriteria kom uit die opdrag en terreinbewyse: toegang bly bruikbaar, versorging is ooreengekom, waterbehoeftes kan nagekom word, en belangrike onbekendes is opgelos of die betrokke werk is uitgestel. 'n Kriterium het bewyse nodig. “Lyk natuurlik” alleen toon nie dat die huishouding dit kan onderhou nie.

key:
A useful connection is more than a line between two objects. Ask what each part needs, what it produces, who cares for it and how things move between the parts. A compost area may receive suitable material and supply finished compost, but someone must sort, carry and manage it. Its position must allow that work and suit local hygiene and site conditions.

Write needs and outputs beside the elements you are considering. Include water, suitable materials, space, access, time and skills. Do not count an output before it is available and suitable for its intended use. A proposed animal system does not provide free fertility: animals also require care, feed, water, welfare and management of wastes.

Look for useful connections, but also conflicts. A convenient position might obstruct a route. One person's useful output might create another person's handling burden. A connection that needs daily attention can fail if nobody agrees to provide it. Keep bought inputs and materials leaving the site in the picture; a neat cycle diagram does not prove that everything is supplied on site.
english:
A useful connection is more than a line between two objects. Ask what each part needs, what it produces, who cares for it and how things move between the parts. A compost area may receive suitable material and supply finished compost, but someone must sort, carry and manage it. Its position must allow that work and suit local hygiene and site conditions.

Write needs and outputs beside the elements you are considering. Include water, suitable materials, space, access, time and skills. Do not count an output before it is available and suitable for its intended use. A proposed animal system does not provide free fertility: animals also require care, feed, water, welfare and management of wastes.

Look for useful connections, but also conflicts. A convenient position might obstruct a route. One person's useful output might create another person's handling burden. A connection that needs daily attention can fail if nobody agrees to provide it. Keep bought inputs and materials leaving the site in the picture; a neat cycle diagram does not prove that everything is supplied on site.
draft:
'n Nuttige verbinding is meer as 'n lyn tussen twee voorwerpe. Vra wat elke deel nodig het, wat dit lewer, wie dit versorg en hoe dinge tussen die dele beweeg. 'n Komposarea kan geskikte materiaal ontvang en klaar kompos verskaf, maar iemand moet dit sorteer, dra en bestuur. Sy posisie moet daardie werk moontlik maak en by plaaslike higiëne en terreintoestande pas.

Skryf behoeftes en uitsette langs die elemente wat jy oorweeg. Sluit water, geskikte materiale, ruimte, toegang, tyd en vaardighede in. Moenie 'n uitset tel voordat dit beskikbaar en geskik is vir die bedoelde gebruik nie. 'n Voorgestelde dierestelsel verskaf nie gratis vrugbaarheid nie: diere vereis ook versorging, voer, water, welsyn en bestuur van afval.

Soek na nuttige verbindings, maar ook na botsings. 'n Gerieflike posisie kan 'n roete versper. Een persoon se nuttige uitset kan vir 'n ander persoon 'n hanteringslas skep. 'n Verbinding wat daaglikse aandag nodig het, kan misluk as niemand instem om dit te gee nie. Hou aangekoopte insette en materiale wat die terrein verlaat in die prentjie; 'n netjiese siklusdiagram bewys nie dat alles op die terrein voorsien word nie.

key: The busy yard already connects the home, water point and growing patch through a carrying route. Before adding another system, the learner asks whether the current care journey can be improved. BRIEF-A excludes animals from this phase, so livestock are not added to complete a decorative cycle.
english: The busy yard already connects the home, water point and growing patch through a carrying route. Before adding another system, the learner asks whether the current care journey can be improved. BRIEF-A excludes animals from this phase, so livestock are not added to complete a decorative cycle.
draft: Die besige werf verbind reeds die huis, waterpunt en groeikol deur 'n draroete. Voordat 'n ander stelsel bygevoeg word, vra die leerder of die huidige versorgingsroete verbeter kan word. BRIEF-A sluit diere uit hierdie fase uit, so vee word nie bygevoeg om 'n dekoratiewe siklus te voltooi nie.

key:
A first idea is a starting point. Make different concept arrangements while changes are still easy. Keep the same brief, base map and evidence for each. A comparison is unfair if one option receives an imaginary water supply or unpaid labour while the other must use the recorded resources.

A concept shows the main relationships and intended uses. It does not yet settle every dimension or technical detail. Use a proposal overlay so existing features remain visible. Label what is retained, changed, added or deferred. Keep unresolved matters beside the affected part of each option.

Make the alternatives genuinely useful. They might compare improving an existing growing area with relocating it, or a modest first phase with later expansion. Do not make one option deliberately foolish so your favourite wins. Keeping the present arrangement while gathering evidence can also be a reasonable option.
english:
A first idea is a starting point. Make different concept arrangements while changes are still easy. Keep the same brief, base map and evidence for each. A comparison is unfair if one option receives an imaginary water supply or unpaid labour while the other must use the recorded resources.

A concept shows the main relationships and intended uses. It does not yet settle every dimension or technical detail. Use a proposal overlay so existing features remain visible. Label what is retained, changed, added or deferred. Keep unresolved matters beside the affected part of each option.

Make the alternatives genuinely useful. They might compare improving an existing growing area with relocating it, or a modest first phase with later expansion. Do not make one option deliberately foolish so your favourite wins. Keeping the present arrangement while gathering evidence can also be a reasonable option.
draft:
'n Eerste idee is 'n beginpunt. Maak verskillende konseprangskikkings terwyl veranderinge nog maklik is. Hou dieselfde opdrag, basiskaart en bewyse vir elkeen. 'n Vergelyking is onregverdig as een opsie 'n denkbeeldige watervoorsiening of onbetaalde arbeid kry terwyl die ander die aangetekende hulpbronne moet gebruik.

'n Konsep wys die hoofverhoudings en bedoelde gebruike. Dit bepaal nog nie elke afmeting of tegniese besonderheid nie. Gebruik 'n voorsteloorleg sodat bestaande kenmerke sigbaar bly. Merk wat behou, verander, bygevoeg of uitgestel word. Hou onopgeloste sake langs die betrokke deel van elke opsie.

Maak die alternatiewe werklik nuttig. Hulle kan die verbetering van 'n bestaande groeiarea met die verskuiwing daarvan vergelyk, of 'n beskeie eerste fase met latere uitbreiding. Moenie een opsie doelbewus dwaas maak sodat jou gunsteling wen nie. Om die huidige rangskikking te behou terwyl bewyse ingesamel word, kan ook 'n redelike opsie wees.

key:
Compare the options against the criteria you wrote from the brief. Start with needs that cannot be traded away: usable access, agreed care, required permissions and a proposal's basic suitability. Then consider benefits, burdens, costs and what may change over time.

Use words and evidence references. “Possible, but water evidence is missing” is more honest than a precise-looking score with no basis. If you use a scoring exercise, agree what each score means and who chooses the priorities. Adding scores must not cancel an unresolved safety or permission requirement.

Ask the household to explain the choice in its own words. A designer's preference should not quietly replace the household's priorities. Record why an option was chosen, why another was set aside and what new information could change the decision. A conditional choice is valid when its condition is clear and the affected work waits.
english:
Compare the options against the criteria you wrote from the brief. Start with needs that cannot be traded away: usable access, agreed care, required permissions and a proposal's basic suitability. Then consider benefits, burdens, costs and what may change over time.

Use words and evidence references. “Possible, but water evidence is missing” is more honest than a precise-looking score with no basis. If you use a scoring exercise, agree what each score means and who chooses the priorities. Adding scores must not cancel an unresolved safety or permission requirement.

Ask the household to explain the choice in its own words. A designer's preference should not quietly replace the household's priorities. Record why an option was chosen, why another was set aside and what new information could change the decision. A conditional choice is valid when its condition is clear and the affected work waits.
draft:
Vergelyk die opsies met die kriteria wat jy uit die opdrag geskryf het. Begin met behoeftes wat nie verruil kan word nie: bruikbare toegang, ooreengekome versorging, vereiste toestemmings en 'n voorstel se basiese geskiktheid. Oorweeg dan voordele, laste, koste en wat oor tyd kan verander.

Gebruik woorde en bewysverwysings. “Moontlik, maar waterbewyse ontbreek” is eerliker as 'n telling wat presies lyk maar geen grondslag het nie. As jy 'n puntetoekenningsoefening gebruik, kom ooreen wat elke telling beteken en wie die prioriteite kies. Om tellings op te tel, mag nie 'n onopgeloste veiligheids- of toestemmingsvereiste kanselleer nie.

Vra die huishouding om die keuse in hul eie woorde te verduidelik. 'n Ontwerper se voorkeur moet nie stilweg die huishouding se prioriteite vervang nie. Teken aan waarom 'n opsie gekies is, waarom 'n ander opsy gesit is en watter nuwe inligting die besluit kan verander. 'n Voorwaardelike keuse is geldig wanneer die voorwaarde duidelik is en die betrokke werk wag.

key: Design and evidence guides. Keep versions of alternative concepts; do not overwrite the existing base or silently change measured features when comparing layouts.
english: Design and evidence guides. Keep versions of alternative concepts; do not overwrite the existing base or silently change measured features when comparing layouts.
draft: Ontwerp- en bewysgidse. Hou weergawes van alternatiewe konsepte; moenie die bestaande basis oorskryf of gemete kenmerke stilweg verander wanneer jy uitlegte vergelyk nie.

key:
A concept explains an arrangement. A developed layout must also show whether its parts fit the available space. Return to the base-map measurements. Check the boundaries relevant to the work, the existing features, access and the distances needed to place the proposal. Keep the measurement method and units with the record.

Use a consistent scale for the plan. Check a known distance against that scale rather than trusting how large the picture looks on a screen. Resizing an image can change its printed scale. A dimension label and the drawn geometry should agree; if they disagree, find the source of the error before using either.

Allow for working access and the needs of the selected system. Do not borrow a universal spacing from a decorative drawing. Use the approved technical source for the actual crop, structure or system, including growth and maintenance needs. If the required dimension is unknown, mark that part incomplete.
english:
A concept explains an arrangement. A developed layout must also show whether its parts fit the available space. Return to the base-map measurements. Check the boundaries relevant to the work, the existing features, access and the distances needed to place the proposal. Keep the measurement method and units with the record.

Use a consistent scale for the plan. Check a known distance against that scale rather than trusting how large the picture looks on a screen. Resizing an image can change its printed scale. A dimension label and the drawn geometry should agree; if they disagree, find the source of the error before using either.

Allow for working access and the needs of the selected system. Do not borrow a universal spacing from a decorative drawing. Use the approved technical source for the actual crop, structure or system, including growth and maintenance needs. If the required dimension is unknown, mark that part incomplete.
draft:
'n Konsep verduidelik 'n rangskikking. 'n Ontwikkelde uitleg moet ook wys of sy dele in die beskikbare ruimte pas. Gaan terug na die basiskaart se metings. Kontroleer die grense wat vir die werk tersaaklik is, die bestaande kenmerke, toegang en die afstande wat nodig is om die voorstel te plaas. Hou die meetmetode en eenhede by die rekord.

Gebruik 'n konsekwente skaal vir die plan. Kontroleer 'n bekende afstand teen daardie skaal eerder as om te vertrou op hoe groot die prent op 'n skerm lyk. Om 'n beeld se grootte te verander, kan sy gedrukte skaal verander. 'n Afmetingsetiket en die getekende meetkunde moet ooreenstem; as hulle verskil, vind die bron van die fout voordat jy enigeen gebruik.

Maak voorsiening vir werktoegang en die behoeftes van die gekose stelsel. Moenie 'n universele spasiëring uit 'n dekoratiewe tekening leen nie. Gebruik die goedgekeurde tegniese bron vir die werklike gewas, struktuur of stelsel, insluitend groei- en onderhoudsbehoeftes. As die vereiste afmeting onbekend is, merk daardie deel as onvolledig.

key: On a measured practice site supplied by the facilitator, reconcile the written dimensions, units and scaled drawing. Point to the information that establishes fit. On your own design, mark any proposal still awaiting measurement or technical dimensions. Do not conduct unsafe or specialist surveying as an unsupervised course task.
english: On a measured practice site supplied by the facilitator, reconcile the written dimensions, units and scaled drawing. Point to the information that establishes fit. On your own design, mark any proposal still awaiting measurement or technical dimensions. Do not conduct unsafe or specialist surveying as an unsupervised course task.
draft: Versoen die geskrewe afmetings, eenhede en skaaltekening op 'n gemete oefenterrein wat die fasiliteerder verskaf. Wys na die inligting wat bewys dat iets pas. Merk op jou eie ontwerp enige voorstel wat nog op meting of tegniese afmetings wag. Moenie onveilige of gespesialiseerde opmeting as 'n kursustaak sonder toesig doen nie.

key:
Fitting the objects is only one check. Follow the people, water, materials and maintenance journeys between them. Check that a route remains usable when people carry tools or produce. Ask whether a mature planting or a stored material could obstruct access that is clear in today's drawing.

Look beyond the selected area. A water change can affect places downstream; a fence can affect shared access. Record the people and resources affected. The design folder should identify relevant permissions and technical advice, not assume them from a boundary line or software tool.

Ask how the system behaves when something goes wrong. If supply is interrupted, who responds? If a component blocks or overflows, where could the problem go? Technical designs need appropriate assessment; do not invent a safe outlet or drainage capacity. When evidence is incomplete, hold the affected work and explain the dependency.
english:
Fitting the objects is only one check. Follow the people, water, materials and maintenance journeys between them. Check that a route remains usable when people carry tools or produce. Ask whether a mature planting or a stored material could obstruct access that is clear in today's drawing.

Look beyond the selected area. A water change can affect places downstream; a fence can affect shared access. Record the people and resources affected. The design folder should identify relevant permissions and technical advice, not assume them from a boundary line or software tool.

Ask how the system behaves when something goes wrong. If supply is interrupted, who responds? If a component blocks or overflows, where could the problem go? Technical designs need appropriate assessment; do not invent a safe outlet or drainage capacity. When evidence is incomplete, hold the affected work and explain the dependency.
draft:
Om die voorwerpe te laat pas, is net een kontrole. Volg die roetes van mense, water, materiale en onderhoud tussen hulle. Kontroleer dat 'n roete bruikbaar bly wanneer mense gereedskap of produkte dra. Vra of 'n volwasse aanplanting of 'n gebergde materiaal toegang kan versper wat in vandag se tekening oop is.

Kyk verder as die gekose area. 'n Waterverandering kan plekke stroomaf raak; 'n heining kan gedeelde toegang raak. Teken die mense en hulpbronne aan wat geraak word. Die ontwerplêer moet tersaaklike toestemmings en tegniese advies identifiseer, nie dit uit 'n grenslyn of sagtewarehulpmiddel aanneem nie.

Vra hoe die stelsel optree wanneer iets verkeerd loop. As voorsiening onderbreek word, wie reageer? As 'n komponent verstop of oorloop, waarheen kan die probleem gaan? Tegniese ontwerpe het gepaste beoordeling nodig; moenie 'n veilige uitlaat of dreineringskapasiteit versin nie. Wanneer bewyse onvolledig is, hou die betrokke werk terug en verduidelik die afhanklikheid.

key: Does the presence of a Water or Earthworks tool mean any placement it accepts is suitable?
english: Does the presence of a Water or Earthworks tool mean any placement it accepts is suitable?
draft: Beteken die teenwoordigheid van 'n Water- of Grondwerke-hulpmiddel dat enige plasing wat dit aanvaar, geskik is?

key:
A plan communicates decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Distinguish existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels near the correct features without covering essential details.

Separate information when a single sheet becomes crowded. A base map, analysis overlay, proposal and phase sheet can tell different parts of the same story. Keep feature names and references consistent between them. The cost record and care plan should refer to the same items shown on the map.

Inspect the actual export at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or printed sheet? Are labels clipped? Does the legend describe things that are really present? Does decorative artwork hide a path or imply features that were never recorded? Correct the output and check again.
english:
A plan communicates decisions. Give it a clear title, revision and purpose. Show orientation, scale status, units, legend and sources. Distinguish existing features from proposed changes and unresolved information using labels or patterns as well as colour. Keep labels near the correct features without covering essential details.

Separate information when a single sheet becomes crowded. A base map, analysis overlay, proposal and phase sheet can tell different parts of the same story. Keep feature names and references consistent between them. The cost record and care plan should refer to the same items shown on the map.

Inspect the actual export at the size it will be used. Can someone read it on a phone or printed sheet? Are labels clipped? Does the legend describe things that are really present? Does decorative artwork hide a path or imply features that were never recorded? Correct the output and check again.
draft:
'n Plan kommunikeer besluite. Gee dit 'n duidelike titel, hersiening en doel. Wys oriëntasie, skaalstatus, eenhede, sleutel en bronne. Onderskei bestaande kenmerke van voorgestelde veranderinge en onopgeloste inligting met etikette of patrone sowel as kleur. Hou etikette naby die regte kenmerke sonder om noodsaaklike besonderhede te bedek.

Skei inligting wanneer een blad te vol word. 'n Basiskaart, ontledingsoorleg, voorstel en faseblad kan verskillende dele van dieselfde storie vertel. Hou kenmerkname en verwysings tussen hulle konsekwent. Die kosterekord en versorgingsplan moet na dieselfde items verwys wat op die kaart gewys word.

Ondersoek die werklike uitvoer op die grootte waarop dit gebruik sal word. Kan iemand dit op 'n foon of gedrukte blad lees? Is etikette afgesny? Beskryf die sleutel dinge wat werklik teenwoordig is? Verberg dekoratiewe kunswerk 'n paadjie of suggereer dit kenmerke wat nooit aangeteken is nie? Stel die uitset reg en kontroleer weer.

key: MAP-A keeps its “not to scale” status in every export. A proposal view must not lose that limitation merely because it receives a polished background. The learner uses separate labels for the retained patch and any future idea.

key:
A phase is a manageable part of the work. Its place in the sequence depends on what must be ready first. Start with the design decision, then list its prerequisites: permission, measurements, advice, suitable materials, resources, access and the people who will care for it.

Distinguish investigating from implementing. Obtaining a quotation does not commit you to buying. Marking a proposed area for discussion does not authorise digging. A design may have useful information-gathering steps even while construction is on hold.

Choose a first phase that answers the household brief and fits the resources actually agreed. Keep access and existing useful systems working during the change. Describe what would make the phase ready to begin, what would stop it and how you will check its result. Do not begin every component simply because all of them appear in the final vision.

'n Fase is 'n hanteerbare deel van die werk. Sy plek in die volgorde hang af van wat eerste gereed moet wees. Begin met die ontwerpbesluit en lys dan sy voorvereistes: toestemming, metings, advies, geskikte materiale, hulpbronne, toegang en die mense wat dit sal versorg.

Onderskei ondersoek van implementering. Om 'n kwotasie te kry, verbind jou nie om te koop nie. Om 'n voorgestelde area vir bespreking te merk, magtig nie grawe nie. 'n Ontwerp kan nuttige stappe hê om inligting in te samel, selfs terwyl konstruksie teruggehou word.

Kies 'n eerste fase wat die huishouding se opdrag beantwoord en pas by die hulpbronne wat werklik ooreengekom is. Hou toegang en bestaande nuttige stelsels werkend tydens die verandering. Beskryf wat die fase gereed sou maak om te begin, wat dit sou stop en hoe jy die resultaat sal nagaan. Moenie elke komponent begin net omdat almal in die finale visie verskyn nie.

key:
Give proposed items consistent references across the plan and cost record. Derive quantities from a checked design or record their source. Keep unknown quantities unknown. Ask for suitable quotations when a purchase is being considered; do not turn a remembered price into a current supplier offer.

Include the work and supporting materials needed for the proposal, not only its most visible object. Separate one-time purchases from ongoing care costs. Record household contributions honestly. A donated material can still require transport, preparation or maintenance; a volunteer's time still needs agreement.

The date money is needed matters. A future sale does not pay today's bill unless funding is actually available. Use the finance lessons to keep budgets, dated cash forecasts, actual payments and amounts owed distinct. Do not count a hoped-for harvest as confirmed cash or a device-generated plan as proof of profitability.

draft:
Gee voorgestelde items konsekwente verwysings oor die plan en kosterekord heen. Lei hoeveelhede af van 'n nagegaande ontwerp of teken hul bron aan. Hou onbekende hoeveelhede onbekend. Vra vir geskikte kwotasies wanneer 'n aankoop oorweeg word; moenie 'n onthoude prys in 'n huidige aanbod van 'n verskaffer verander nie.

Sluit die werk en ondersteunende materiale in wat vir die voorstel nodig is, nie net sy mees sigbare voorwerp nie. Skei eenmalige aankope van deurlopende versorgingskoste. Teken huishoudelike bydraes eerlik aan. 'n Geskenkte materiaal kan steeds vervoer, voorbereiding of onderhoud vereis; 'n vrywilliger se tyd het steeds 'n ooreenkoms nodig.

Die datum waarop geld nodig is, maak saak. 'n Toekomstige verkoping betaal nie vandag se rekening nie, tensy befondsing werklik beskikbaar is. Gebruik die finansieslesse om begrotings, gedateerde kontantvooruitskattings, werklike betalings en bedrae verskuldig afsonderlik te hou. Moenie 'n gehoopte oes as bevestigde kontant tel of 'n plan wat deur 'n toestel gegenereer is as bewys van winsgewendheid nie.

key:
A design continues after installation. Ask what must be checked, maintained, cleaned, repaired, harvested or recorded. Use the relevant technical lesson and local advice to establish the actual task. Do not assign a generic weekly schedule to living systems with different care needs.

Agree who will do each task and what they need. Ask about normal commitments and absences. A task is not allocated just because a name appears beside it; the person must understand and accept the responsibility. Plan how they will ask for help and what can be reduced if the workload is too much.

Identify relevant disruptions. Water interruptions, damaged access, a missing carer or unavailable materials may change what is feasible. Define a response that preserves welfare and safety. Where the answer depends on specialist advice, record that dependency instead of inventing an emergency procedure.

'n Ontwerp gaan voort ná installering. Vra wat nagegaan, onderhou, skoongemaak, herstel, geoes of aangeteken moet word. Gebruik die tersaaklike tegniese les en plaaslike advies om die werklike taak vas te stel. Moenie 'n algemene weeklikse skedule toeken aan lewende stelsels met verskillende versorgingsbehoeftes nie.

Kom ooreen wie elke taak sal doen en wat hulle nodig het. Vra oor normale verpligtinge en afwesighede. 'n Taak is nie toegewys net omdat 'n naam langsaan verskyn nie; die persoon moet die verantwoordelikheid verstaan en aanvaar. Beplan hoe hulle om hulp sal vra en wat verminder kan word as die werklading te veel is.

Identifiseer tersaaklike ontwrigtings. Wateronderbrekings, beskadigde toegang, 'n afwesige versorger of materiale wat nie beskikbaar is nie, kan verander wat uitvoerbaar is. Omskryf 'n reaksie wat welsyn en veiligheid bewaar. Waar die antwoord van gespesialiseerde advies afhang, teken daardie afhanklikheid aan in plaas daarvan om 'n noodprosedure te versin.

key:
Decide what to observe from the goals in the brief. If access was a priority, ask its users whether the route works and observe it under relevant conditions. If care was a concern, record the tasks and difficulties. A harvest record can inform food production, but it does not alone prove improved household nutrition or income.

Keep a starting record so later observations have context. Record what was actually implemented, when, and any changes from the plan. Note the conditions and other events that may influence the result. Do not attribute every improvement or setback to the design without considering other explanations.

A short course cannot show a whole seasonal outcome. Agree a follow-up appropriate to the decision and the situation, with actual dates set during delivery. If no implementation has occurred, assess the plan and reasoning as such. Do not substitute a generated picture or imagined harvest for observed results.

draft:
Besluit wat om waar te neem op grond van die doelwitte in die opdrag. As toegang 'n prioriteit was, vra die gebruikers daarvan of die roete werk en neem dit onder tersaaklike toestande waar. As versorging 'n bekommernis was, teken die take en probleme aan. 'n Oesrekord kan voedselproduksie inlig, maar dit bewys nie op sy eie verbeterde voeding of inkomste vir die huishouding nie.

Hou 'n beginrekord sodat latere waarnemings konteks het. Teken aan wat werklik geïmplementeer is, wanneer, en enige veranderinge van die plan. Noteer die toestande en ander gebeure wat die resultaat kan beïnvloed. Moenie elke verbetering of terugslag aan die ontwerp toeskryf sonder om ander verklarings te oorweeg nie.

'n Kort kursus kan nie 'n hele seisoen se uitkoms wys nie. Kom 'n opvolg ooreen wat by die besluit en die situasie pas, met werklike datums wat tydens aflewering vasgestel word. As geen implementering plaasgevind het nie, assesseer die plan en redenasie as sodanig. Moenie 'n gegenereerde prent of verbeelde oes in die plek van waargenome resultate stel nie.

key:
Revision is part of design. Keep the previous version, identify the new evidence and explain which decision changes. Check the connected records as well as the drawing. Moving a feature may change access, quantities, costs, water needs or care. A revised map with an old budget can tell a misleading story.

Agree the revised scope with the people affected. Separate work that can proceed from work still needing evidence or advice. Give the person taking over the current plan, source notes, implementation sequence, care responsibilities and unresolved actions. Make the information available in a format they can use without your presence.

Use feedback to plan another attempt where a skill is not yet demonstrated. Finishing the course pages, attending sessions or exporting a map are different from demonstrating the whole design process. Record the actual evidence behind the assessment, and do not turn a course completion label into unsupported specialist authority.

Hersiening is deel van ontwerp. Hou die vorige weergawe, identifiseer die nuwe bewyse en verduidelik watter besluit verander. Kontroleer die gekoppelde rekords sowel as die tekening. Om 'n kenmerk te skuif, kan toegang, hoeveelhede, koste, waterbehoeftes of versorging verander. 'n Hersiene kaart met 'n ou begroting kan 'n misleidende storie vertel.

Kom die hersiene omvang ooreen met die mense wat geraak word. Skei werk wat kan voortgaan van werk wat nog bewyse of advies nodig het. Gee die persoon wat oorneem die huidige plan, bronnotas, implementeringsvolgorde, versorgingsverantwoordelikhede en onopgeloste aksies. Maak die inligting beskikbaar in 'n formaat wat hulle sonder jou teenwoordigheid kan gebruik.

Gebruik terugvoer om nog 'n poging te beplan waar 'n vaardigheid nog nie gedemonstreer is nie. Om die kursusbladsye klaar te maak, sessies by te woon of 'n kaart uit te voer, verskil van die demonstrasie van die hele ontwerpproses. Teken die werklike bewyse agter die assessering aan, en moenie 'n kursusvoltooiingsetiket in onondersteunde gespesialiseerde gesag verander nie.

key:
**BRIEF-A — household discussion.** The household wants vegetables for meals, a route that stays usable between the home and gate, and care work that can fit existing commitments. It does not want animals added in this first phase. The person who usually carries water asks to be included in siting decisions. Another household member needs a route without obstructions. The household agrees to explore options in its existing yard, but that agreement is not a verified boundary survey or permission for work beyond the yard.

**WALK-A — initial visit.** A used route crosses the yard between the home and gate. The existing growing patch lies beside that route. A water point is beside the home. Containers are carried from it to the patch. The eastern part of the yard is shaded during this visit. These observations say nothing yet about the full seasonal shade pattern, water pressure, available volume, water quality or production potential.

**TALK-A — reported history.** A resident says water has crossed the eastern part during heavy rain. No rain is falling on the first visit. Record the resident's experience as reported information, with consent; do not replace it with an invented slope arrow or present it as a measured flood level.

**MAP-A — first sketch.** It locates the home, gate, used route, water point, existing patch and the area mentioned in TALK-A relative to each other. It is labelled “not to scale; boundary, north and dimensions need checking”. No compass direction is derived from an unverified photograph. The supplied statement that part of the yard is eastern is a case description, not a direction the learner has measured.

**RESOURCES-A — current limits.** Available care time, reliable water supply, soil conditions, material quantities and costs are not yet recorded. No other person's labour or money is promised. No neighbour's land, water route or access is available merely because it appears on a picture.

draft:
**BRIEF-A — huishoudingsgesprek.** Die huishouding wil groente vir maaltye hê, 'n roete wat tussen die huis en hek bruikbaar bly, en versorgingswerk wat by bestaande verpligtinge kan inpas. Hulle wil nie in hierdie eerste fase diere byvoeg nie. Die persoon wat gewoonlik water dra, vra om by plasingsbesluite ingesluit te word. Nog 'n huishoudingslid het 'n roete sonder versperrings nodig. Die huishouding stem in om opsies in sy bestaande werf te verken, maar daardie instemming is nie 'n geverifieerde grensopmeting of toestemming vir werk buite die werf nie.

**WALK-A — eerste besoek.** 'n Gebruikte roete kruis die werf tussen die huis en hek. Die bestaande groeikol lê langs daardie roete. 'n Waterpunt is langs die huis. Houers word daarvandaan na die kol gedra. Die oostelike deel van die werf is tydens hierdie besoek in die skadu. Hierdie waarnemings sê nog niks oor die volle seisoenale skadupatroon, waterdruk, beskikbare volume, watergehalte of produksiepotensiaal nie.

**TALK-A — gerapporteerde geskiedenis.** 'n Inwoner sê water het tydens swaar reën oor die oostelike deel gevloei. Geen reën val tydens die eerste besoek nie. Teken die inwoner se ervaring met toestemming as gerapporteerde inligting aan; moenie dit met 'n versinde hellingpyl vervang of dit as 'n gemete vloedvlak aanbied nie.

**MAP-A — eerste skets.** Dit plaas die huis, hek, gebruikte roete, waterpunt, bestaande kol en die area wat in TALK-A genoem word, ten opsigte van mekaar. Dit is gemerk “nie volgens skaal nie; grens, noord en afmetings moet nagegaan word”. Geen kompasrigting word van 'n ongeverifieerde foto afgelei nie. Die verskafde stelling dat 'n deel van die werf oostelik is, is 'n beskrywing van die geval, nie 'n rigting wat die leerder gemeet het nie.

**RESOURCES-A — huidige perke.** Beskikbare versorgingstyd, betroubare watervoorsiening, grondtoestande, materiaalhoeveelhede en koste is nog nie aangeteken nie. Niemand anders se arbeid of geld word belowe nie. Geen buurman se grond, waterroete of toegang is beskikbaar net omdat dit op 'n prent verskyn nie.

key:
### D1 — what is the task?

The brief prioritises food, usable access and manageable care. Adding a pond or animals is not a stated need. The facilitator asks the people doing the work what they can maintain and what must remain clear. The learner records missing resource information instead of assigning an imaginary budget.

On the first map the growing patch is an existing feature. An idea for a new patch belongs on a proposal overlay. The learner does not erase the used route because it interrupts the picture. The family report about rain is kept beside its source; it is not changed into an observed event.

### D2 — what do the facts mean?

The daily watering journey makes convenient access worth investigating. It does not prove that the closest possible location is suitable. The shade snapshot needs further seasonal evidence, and the reported water route needs examination before considering an intervention.

The learner writes: “Can we improve care of the existing patch while keeping the route usable?” This is a design question. “Build a swale through the eastern yard” would jump past the missing terrain, water, suitability and permission evidence.

For the next safe visit, the learner asks the household to show how people move through the space. They arrange further shade observations and ask who can help assess the reported water problem. They do not enter dangerous runoff to obtain a photograph. They keep all three options open: improve the existing patch, consider another suitable location, or defer expansion until resources are known.

draft:
### D1 — wat is die taak?

Die opdrag gee voorrang aan kos, bruikbare toegang en hanteerbare versorging. Om 'n dam of diere by te voeg, is nie 'n gestelde behoefte nie. Die fasiliteerder vra die mense wat die werk doen wat hulle kan onderhou en wat oop moet bly. Die leerder teken ontbrekende inligting oor hulpbronne aan in plaas daarvan om 'n denkbeeldige begroting toe te ken.

Op die eerste kaart is die groeikol 'n bestaande kenmerk. 'n Idee vir 'n nuwe kol hoort op 'n voorsteloorleg. Die leerder vee nie die gebruikte roete uit omdat dit die prent onderbreek nie. Die gesin se verslag oor reën word by sy bron gehou; dit word nie in 'n waargenome gebeurtenis verander nie.

### D2 — wat beteken die feite?

Die daaglikse natleiroete maak gerieflike toegang die moeite werd om te ondersoek. Dit bewys nie dat die naaste moontlike ligging geskik is nie. Die skadu-momentopname het verdere seisoenale bewyse nodig, en die gerapporteerde waterroete moet ondersoek word voordat 'n ingryping oorweeg word.

Die leerder skryf: “Kan ons die versorging van die bestaande kol verbeter terwyl die roete bruikbaar bly?” Dit is 'n ontwerpvraag. “Bou 'n kontoersloot deur die oostelike werf” sou verby die ontbrekende bewyse oor terrein, water, geskiktheid en toestemming spring.

Vir die volgende veilige besoek vra die leerder die huishouding om te wys hoe mense deur die ruimte beweeg. Hulle reël verdere skadu-waarnemings en vra wie kan help om die gerapporteerde waterprobleem te beoordeel. Hulle gaan nie in gevaarlike afloop in om 'n foto te kry nie. Hulle hou al drie opsies oop: verbeter die bestaande kol, oorweeg 'n ander geskikte ligging, of stel uitbreiding uit totdat hulpbronne bekend is.

key:
Concept A investigates improving care of the existing patch. Concept B investigates a different location while retaining the access route. Both must meet BRIEF-A. A has not been shown to cost less; B has not been shown to produce more. Both still need the resource and site checks recorded in D1–D2. The provisional preference for investigating A is based on manageable care and existing access, not an invented performance advantage. Do not add new dimensions or resource quantities silently. When a later source card supplies information, identify what changed, why it is credible within the case and which earlier decision it affects.

A completed worked example must eventually show a scaled source pack, concept comparison, developed layout, dependencies and care, a cost/unknown record and a revision after feedback. This file currently supplies the brief, analysis and conditional concept comparison; it is not that completed example. D4–D6 lesson text is drafted, but the measured demonstration, actual plan set and supplied later-evidence/revision exercise remain unfinished.

Daar is nie gewys dat A minder kos nie; daar is nie gewys dat B meer lewer nie. Albei het steeds die hulpbron- en terreinkontroles nodig wat in D1–D2 aangeteken is. Die voorlopige voorkeur om A te ondersoek, berus op hanteerbare versorging en bestaande toegang, nie op 'n versinde prestasievoordeel nie. Moenie stilweg nuwe afmetings of hulpbronhoeveelhede byvoeg nie. Wanneer 'n latere bronkaart inligting verskaf, identifiseer wat verander het, waarom dit binne die geval geloofwaardig is en watter vroeër besluit dit raak.

'n Voltooide uitgewerkte voorbeeld moet uiteindelik 'n bronpakket volgens skaal, konsepvergelyking, ontwikkelde uitleg, afhanklikhede en versorging, 'n rekord van koste/onbekendes en 'n hersiening ná terugvoer wys. Hierdie lêer verskaf tans die opdrag, ontleding en voorwaardelike konsepvergelyking; dit is nie daardie voltooide voorbeeld nie. Lesteks vir D4–D6 is opgestel, maar die gemete demonstrasie, werklike planstel en verskafde oefening met latere bewyse/hersiening is nog onvoltooid.

key:
Use a notebook, calculator and the event cards below. Learners may point, sort or explain aloud. Read each card aloud before introducing a table. Do not ask anyone to reveal household income, borrowing, customer details or bank records to a group.

**Every amount below is invented solely for arithmetic practice.** These are neither local prices nor recommended budgets. “Day 1” through “Day 7” are an imaginary week. There is one practice farm, one owner and one cash tin. No bank account, tax, opening debt, opening customer balance, refunds or other cash movements are in this example. The opening R1,000 is counted money already in the tin, not a new sale. The cash result is complete for this deliberately bounded example; its production costs and profit are not complete.

Show each card's reference beside the written entry. All events and amounts are also available in [f1-practice.json](f1-practice.json). The JSON uses whole cents to keep arithmetic exact; learner-facing materials use rand and cents.

key: Read [Record and check a harvest](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/harvest). The current form records kilograms and the date of entry, not a backdated picking date. The chart's “kept” is picked minus logged sold quantities; it cannot identify home use, gifts, storage or loss separately. In this workbook, 24 kg picked minus 15 kg delivered is 9 kg; that happens to equal closing stock because the 4 kg opening stock and 4 kg other outflows offset. It is a coincidence, not a general stock formula or an expected app chart result. The current invoice link adds kilogram sale evidence when an invoice is paid in full, so unpaid and partly paid deliveries do not map directly to this workbook. Use its destination records to explain the movement; do not mark an invoice paid just to force the chart to match.

key:
Use the [learner worksheet](f2-worksheet.md) or [four-page printable workbook](../../../../output/pdf/finance-f2-workbook.pdf), a calculator, a notebook and counters representing kilograms and money. Read one event aloud at a time. Let learners point, sort cards, explain aloud or ask someone to write their answer. Introduce the second money account only after the learner can follow the cash tin. Keep real household finances, buyer details and payment credentials out of group exercises and screenshots.

All weights, prices, fees and amounts in this pack are invented for arithmetic practice. They are not local market evidence, recommended fees, budgets or yields. This is a separate four-day practice period for the fictional farm; do not carry forward or add F1's balances. The opening position is given: 4 kg of carrots already stored, R500.00 in a cash tin and R100.00 in a mobile-money wallet, with no buyer balance owed. No field area or production period is supplied, so no yield per area can be calculated.

The exercise tracks the same produce in comparable weighed condition. It excludes purchases, processing, refunds, unknown shrinkage, pending transfers, tax, loans and equipment. In real work, identify additional movements and changes in weighing conditions rather than forcing them into this example. No numerical loss allowance is recommended. Exact quantities are stored as whole grams and money as whole cents in [f2-practice.json](f2-practice.json); the teaching tables use kg and rand.

draft:
Gebruik die [leerderwerkblad](f2-worksheet.md) of [drukbare werkboek van vier bladsye](../../../../output/pdf/finance-f2-workbook.pdf), 'n sakrekenaar, 'n notaboek en tellers wat kilogram en geld voorstel. Lees een gebeurtenis op 'n slag hardop. Laat leerders wys, kaarte sorteer, hardop verduidelik of iemand vra om hul antwoord neer te skryf. Stel die tweede geldrekening eers bekend nadat die leerder die kontantblik kan volg. Hou werklike huishoudelike finansies, koperbesonderhede en betaalgeloofsbriewe uit groepoefeninge en skermskote.

Alle gewigte, pryse, fooie en bedrae in hierdie pakket is vir rekenoefening versin. Dit is nie plaaslike markbewyse, aanbevole fooie, begrotings of opbrengste nie. Dit is 'n afsonderlike oefentydperk van vier dae vir die fiktiewe plaas; moenie F1 se saldo's oordra of byvoeg nie. Die openingsposisie word gegee: 4 kg wortels reeds geberg, R500.00 in 'n kontantblik en R100.00 in 'n selfoongeldbeursie, met geen kopersaldo verskuldig nie. Geen veldoppervlakte of produksietydperk word verskaf nie, so geen opbrengs per oppervlakte kan bereken word nie.

Die oefening volg dieselfde produkte in vergelykbare geweegde toestand. Dit sluit aankope, verwerking, terugbetalings, onbekende krimping, hangende oordragte, belasting, lenings en toerusting uit. Identifiseer in werklike werk bykomende bewegings en veranderinge in wegingstoestande eerder as om dit in hierdie voorbeeld in te dwing. Geen numeriese verliestoelaag word aanbeveel nie. Presiese hoeveelhede word as heel gram en geld as heel sente in [f2-practice.json](f2-practice.json) gestoor; die onderrigtabelle gebruik kg en rand.

key:
Place A01-A04 beneath their own crop headings. A05 is one hire bill for R120.00. The equipment record shows two hours for carrots and four for the second crop: carrots receive 2/6 of the bill, the second crop 4/6. Together the shares must still equal the one bill. A06 is a separate R90.00 market trip. Its agreed practice basis is occupied equal-size crate spaces, two for carrots and one for the other crop. Explain why this bill uses a different record.

There is no universal rule that hours or crate spaces always give the fairest allocation. Ask what caused the shared cost and whether the record describes it. The chosen basis must fit the decision and period. If the usage record is missing, show an unallocated amount and investigate. Do not quietly assign it all to the crop that looks most profitable.

draft:
Plaas A01-A04 onder hul eie gewasopskrifte. A05 is een huurrekening vir R120.00. Die toerustingrekord wys twee uur vir wortels en vier vir die tweede gewas: wortels kry 2/6 van die rekening, die tweede gewas 4/6. Saam moet die dele steeds gelyk wees aan die een rekening. A06 is 'n afsonderlike markrit van R90.00. Die ooreengekome oefenbasis daarvan is bestekte kratspasies van gelyke grootte, twee vir wortels en een vir die ander gewas. Verduidelik waarom hierdie rekening 'n ander rekord gebruik.

Daar is geen universele reël dat ure of kratspasies altyd die regverdigste toedeling gee nie. Vra wat die gedeelde koste veroorsaak het en of die rekord dit beskryf. Die gekose basis moet by die besluit en tydperk pas. As die gebruiksrekord ontbreek, wys 'n ontoegedeelde bedrag en ondersoek dit. Moenie dit stilweg alles toeken aan die gewas wat die winsgewendste lyk nie.

The app's current records are not proof that every cost has been included.

key: Choose one small practice enterprise. Name its product, unit and period. Collect three redacted cost references, identify a shared cost and record a possible allocation basis. List missing evidence. Do not require learners to disclose private household finances.

draft: Kies een klein oefenonderneming. Noem sy produk, eenheid en tydperk. Versamel drie geredigeerde kosteverwysings, identifiseer 'n gedeelde koste en teken 'n moontlike toedelingsbasis aan. Lys ontbrekende bewyse. Moenie vereis dat leerders private huishoudelike finansies bekend maak nie.

key:
The carrot exercise has R220.00 of assigned paid costs and 40 kg of marketable produce. That is R5.50 per marketable kg for those included costs. With the separate R100.00 family-time comparison, the total becomes R320.00, or R8.00 per marketable kg. These are two labelled views of one budget, not two bills to add.

If only 32 kg is expected to sell, recovering that same R320.00 entirely through those sales requires R10.00 per kg sold. This is a **sales-recovery planning target**, not the accounting cost of each item sold or a promise that a buyer will pay it. The other 8 kg is not automatically lost or household food; investigate its destination and value. Do not write off closing stock simply because it has not sold. Missing land, equipment, administration, finance and tax information means full profit is still unknown.

draft:
Die wortel-oefening het R220.00 se toegekende betaalde koste en 40 kg bemarkbare produkte. Dit is R5.50 per bemarkbare kg vir daardie ingesluite koste. Met die afsonderlike vergelyking van gesinstyd van R100.00 word die totaal R320.00, of R8.00 per bemarkbare kg. Dit is twee gemerkte aansigte van een begroting, nie twee rekenings om bymekaar te tel nie.

As net 32 kg na verwagting sal verkoop, vereis die herwinning van daardie selfde R320.00 geheel en al deur daardie verkope R10.00 per kg verkoop. Dit is 'n **beplanningsteiken vir herwinning deur verkope**, nie die rekeningkundige koste van elke item wat verkoop is nie, of 'n belofte dat 'n koper dit sal betaal. Die ander 8 kg is nie outomaties verlore of kos vir die huishouding nie; ondersoek die bestemming en waarde daarvan. Moenie slotvoorraad afskryf net omdat dit nie verkoop het nie. Ontbrekende inligting oor grond, toerusting, administrasie, finansiering en belasting beteken volle wins is steeds onbekend.

key:
At 30 packs, calculate revenue and both kinds of included cost. Repeat for 18 packs prepared and sold. Then keep the original prices but reduce capacity to 20. The numerical break-even point does not change, but it is outside that capacity. Never recommend “sell more” without testing production capacity and evidence of demand. Expected sales are assumptions, not confirmed orders.

If price equals or is below variable cost while fixed costs remain positive, more units do not cover those fixed costs under this model. Report no feasible break-even quantity under these assumptions, not zero units. If a cost is missing, the result is unknown; an empty value is not a free input.
english:

The numerical break-even point does not change, but it is outside that capacity. Never recommend “sell more” without testing production capacity and evidence of demand. Expected sales are assumptions, not confirmed orders.

If price equals or is below variable cost while fixed costs remain positive, more units do not cover those fixed costs under this model. Report no feasible break-even quantity under these assumptions, not zero units. If a cost is missing, the result is unknown; an empty value is not a free input.
draft:
Bereken by 30 pakke die inkomste en albei soorte ingesluite koste. Herhaal vir 18 pakke voorberei en verkoop. Hou dan die oorspronklike pryse maar verminder kapasiteit na 20. Die numeriese gelykbreekpunt verander nie, maar dit lê buite daardie kapasiteit. Moet nooit “verkoop meer” aanbeveel sonder om produksiekapasiteit en bewyse van vraag te toets nie. Verwagte verkope is aannames, nie bevestigde bestellings nie.

As die prys gelyk is aan of laer is as die veranderlike koste terwyl vaste koste positief bly, dek meer eenhede nie daardie vaste koste onder hierdie model nie. Rapporteer geen uitvoerbare gelykbreekhoeveelheid onder hierdie aannames nie, nie nul eenhede nie. As 'n koste ontbreek, is die resultaat onbekend; 'n leë waarde is nie 'n gratis inset nie.

key: Keep these what-if calculations in the workbook. Do not enter forecast sales as actual sales in My Records. Use the existing expense and harvest guides to find the underlying real records. A chart based on saved rows does not supply a missing stock valuation, family-time value or depreciation policy.

draft: Hou hierdie wat-as-berekeninge in die werkboek. Moenie voorspelde verkope as werklike verkope in My rekords invoer nie. Gebruik die bestaande uitgawe- en oesgidse om die onderliggende werklike rekords te vind. 'n Grafiek gebaseer op gestoorde rye verskaf nie 'n ontbrekende voorraadwaardasie, waarde vir gesinstyd of waardeverminderingsbeleid nie.

key:
Decision C offers the same 20 kg of accepted produce to either Buyer A or Buyer B. A offers R10.00/kg, collects it, requires no extra packaging and pays on Day 0. B offers R12.00/kg, but the grower pays R35.00 delivery and R10.00 additional packaging; B promises payment on Day 7. These are alternatives, not two simultaneous sales of the same produce.

A leaves R200.00 after the specified offer-specific cash costs. B leaves R195.00. A's lower headline price leaves R5.00 more at that stage. Both options also relate to R140.00 of already-incurred common costs; subtracting those gives R60.00 and R55.00, respectively. Those are partial results, not full profit. Do not charge the common cost twice or add the two offers together.

The cards separately record additional unpaid selling work: half an hour for A, one and a half for B. At the same hypothetical comparison value, that adds R12.50 or R37.50 to the management view, leaving R47.50 or R17.50 after the specified common costs and additional family-time value. The farm has not paid those wages. Other omitted work or costs could still change the full result.

draft:
Besluit C bied dieselfde 20 kg aanvaarde produkte aan óf Koper A óf Koper B. A bied R10.00/kg, haal dit self af, vereis geen ekstra verpakking nie en betaal op Dag 0. B bied R12.00/kg, maar die kweker betaal R35.00 aflewering en R10.00 bykomende verpakking; B belowe betaling op Dag 7. Dit is alternatiewe, nie twee gelyktydige verkope van dieselfde produkte nie.

A laat R200.00 oor ná die gespesifiseerde aanbodspesifieke kontantkoste. B laat R195.00 oor. A se laer opskrifprys laat op daardie stadium R5.00 meer oor. Albei opsies hou ook verband met R140.00 se reeds aangegane gemeenskaplike koste; as dit afgetrek word, gee dit onderskeidelik R60.00 en R55.00. Dit is gedeeltelike resultate, nie volle wins nie. Moenie die gemeenskaplike koste twee keer hef of die twee aanbiedinge bymekaar tel nie.

Die kaarte teken afsonderlik bykomende onbetaalde verkoopwerk aan: 'n halfuur vir A, een en 'n half uur vir B. Teen dieselfde hipotetiese vergelykingswaarde voeg dit R12.50 of R37.50 by die bestuursaansig, wat R47.50 of R17.50 oorlaat ná die gespesifiseerde gemeenskaplike koste en bykomende waarde vir gesinstyd. Die plaas het nie daardie lone betaal nie. Ander weggelate werk of koste kan steeds die volle resultaat verander.

key: State what the supplied evidence favours: A retains more after these specified costs, requires less additional time and pays earlier. Do not claim the buyer is reliable merely because the card promises payment. Ask about confirmed quantities, acceptance standards, rejections, collection arrangements and how the agreement will be recorded. A real buyer relationship may have advantages the cards do not describe; name those separately rather than inventing a monetary score.

Vra oor bevestigde hoeveelhede, aanvaardingstandaarde, afkeurings, afhaalreëlings en hoe die ooreenkoms aangeteken sal word. 'n Werklike verhouding met 'n koper kan voordele hê wat die kaarte nie beskryf nie; noem dit afsonderlik eerder as om 'n monetêre telling te versin.

key: The [invoice guide](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/invoices) covers checking the buyer, units, amounts and payment status after an agreement. 'n Faktuur is nie bewys dat betaling opgedaag het nie. Koppel 'n bestaande aangetekende verkoping eerder as om dit weer aan te teken. Hierdie alternatiewe kwotasies hoort in die werkboek; moenie twee voorbeeldverkope skep en albei as voltooide besigheid aanbied nie. key:
Bring paper, a calculator and the learner workbook. Read the cards aloud if needed. Learners may point, sort cards or explain their answer to a partner; fluent reading is not the assessment. Begin by asking what it costs to get one product from the garden into a buyer's hands. Keep quantities, time and money on separate lines.

All amounts, weights, work hours and quotes below are **invented classroom inputs**. They are not recommended prices, wages, productivity rates or yields. The R25.00 hourly value is a comparison assumption, not a legal wage or payment instruction. No area, real growing season or tax status is supplied. Do not infer these. A, B and C are separate exercises; do not add their totals or carry forward F1/F2 balances.

Outcomes: assign a cost once; explain the basis for sharing it; keep unpaid work visible; use the right denominator; distinguish markup from margin; test a bounded break-even calculation; and compare buyer terms without equating the highest price with the best outcome.

key:
The source cards give expected sales of R600.00 for A and R500.00 for B. Direct inputs are R220.00 and R180.00. Share the R120.00 hire using recorded planned hours, two for A and four for B. Share the R90.00 trip using two and one equal-size crate spaces. A receives R40.00 hire and R60.00 trip; B receives R80.00 and R30.00. Combined shared allocations remain R210.00, not R420.00.

The budget's specified cash inputs total R610.00. Separately show four and six hours of unpaid family work at the exercise comparison value of R25.00/hour, giving R250.00. That rate is a hypothetical comparison, not a wage recommendation or assertion of outside earning opportunities. After these included costs the two activities show R240.00 in planned surplus. Land, owned-equipment use, administration, finance costs, tax and other missing costs prevent this from establishing full farm profit. Do not add the time comparison to the cash payments.

Die bronkaarte gee verwagte verkope van R600.00 vir A en R500.00 vir B. Direkte insette is R220.00 en R180.00. Deel die R120.00-huur met behulp van aangetekende beplande ure, twee vir A en vier vir B. Deel die R90.00-rit met behulp van twee en een kratspasies van gelyke grootte. A kry R40.00 huur en R60.00 rit; B kry R80.00 en R30.00. Gesamentlike gedeelde toedelings bly R210.00, nie R420.00 nie.

Die begroting se gespesifiseerde kontantinsette beloop R610.00. Wys afsonderlik vier en ses uur onbetaalde gesinswerk teen die oefening se vergelykingswaarde van R25.00/uur, wat R250.00 gee. Daardie tarief is 'n hipotetiese vergelyking, nie 'n loonaanbeveling of 'n bewering oor geleenthede om elders te verdien nie. Ná hierdie ingesluite koste wys die twee aktiwiteite R240.00 se beplande oorskot. Grond, gebruik van eie toerusting, administrasie, finansieringskoste, belasting en ander ontbrekende koste verhoed dat dit volle plaaswins bewys. Moenie die tydvergelyking by die kontantbetalings tel nie.

key: A whole-farm plan also needs the actual availability and timing of land, water, labour, tools and markets. Two activities cannot each be assigned all of the same scarce resource at the same time. This pack supplies cost-sharing hours, not proof that a particular tool or worker is available on the required dates. Keep those checks unresolved until evidence exists. Do not invent a yield from the sales value.

Hierdie pakket verskaf ure vir kostedeling, nie bewys dat 'n bepaalde stuk gereedskap of werker op die vereiste datums beskikbaar is nie. Hou daardie kontroles onopgelos totdat bewyse bestaan. Moenie 'n opbrengs uit die verkoopwaarde versin nie.

key: A new shared R60.00 bill is divided by recorded use of one unit and two units. Allocate it, then check the total. A learner says a R500.00 funding application makes the two activities profitable: ask them to identify approval, cash receipt and whether funding is a sale. Do not assume it is a grant or loan when the terms are absent.

key:
Start at R300.00. Pay the planned R220.00 on 5 January: R80.00 remains. The next planned R180.00 payment on 10 January produces a projected minus R100.00. Stop the cards here and ask how that payment could be made. No borrowing facility or extra money has been supplied. Continue the calculation as a clearly labelled unfunded projection, not as an instruction to pay unavailable cash. The R120.00 hire on 20 January takes it to minus R220.00; the R600.00 receipt on 25 January brings it to R380.00.

The first shortage is 10 January and the deepest base-case shortage is R220.00 after the 20 January payment. January nevertheless closes at positive R380.00. A monthly closing-only check misses the earlier gap. If a receipt and payment share a real date, check which clears first; this exercise avoids same-date ambiguity. Combined available funds also do not prove the right payment account has accessible funds at the required moment.

draft:
Begin by R300.00. Betaal die beplande R220.00 op 5 Januarie: R80.00 bly oor. Die volgende beplande betaling van R180.00 op 10 Januarie lewer 'n geprojekteerde minus R100.00. Stop die kaarte hier en vra hoe daardie betaling gemaak kan word. Geen leningsfasiliteit of ekstra geld is verskaf nie. Gaan voort met die berekening as 'n duidelik gemerkte onbefondsde projeksie, nie as 'n opdrag om onbeskikbare kontant te betaal nie. Die R120.00-huur op 20 Januarie neem dit na minus R220.00; die ontvangs van R600.00 op 25 Januarie bring dit na R380.00.

Die eerste tekort is 10 Januarie en die diepste tekort in die basisgeval is R220.00 ná die betaling op 20 Januarie. Januarie sluit nogtans op positief R380.00. 'n Maandelikse kontrole van net die slotsaldo mis die vroeër gaping. As 'n ontvangs en betaling 'n werklike datum deel, kontroleer watter een eerste deurgaan; hierdie oefening vermy dubbelsinnigheid oor dieselfde datum. Gesamentlike beskikbare fondse bewys ook nie dat die regte betaalrekening op die vereiste oomblik toeganklike fondse het nie.

key:
Continue through February and March. Opening balance plus receipts minus payments equals closing balance. February opens with January's R380.00, not the original R300.00. March's R120.00 collection concerns a customer balance from before the exercise; it is a cash receipt now, not another current-season sale. Paying the old R80.00 supplier bill also needs cash now even though it is not one of these current activity inputs.

Set aside X01, the R50.00 transfer from bank to cash tin: both are already inside the combined cash scope, and the supplied transfer has no fee. It changes location, not the combined amount. Set aside X02, the unapproved R500.00 application. Keep the two issued invoices X03/X04 as links to expected buyer receipts; do not count each invoice and its eventual receipt as two inflows. Family-time comparison is not a payment either.

draft:
Gaan voort deur Februarie en Maart. Openingsaldo plus ontvangste minus betalings is gelyk aan slotsaldo. Februarie open met Januarie se R380.00, nie die oorspronklike R300.00 nie. Maart se invordering van R120.00 gaan oor 'n kliëntsaldo van voor die oefening; dit is nou 'n kontantontvangs, nie nog 'n verkoping in die huidige seisoen nie. Om die ou verskaffersrekening van R80.00 te betaal, vereis ook nou kontant al is dit nie een van hierdie huidige aktiwiteitsinsette nie.

Sit X01 opsy, die oordrag van R50.00 van bank na kontantblik: albei is reeds binne die gesamentlike kontantomvang, en die verskafde oordrag het geen fooi nie. Dit verander die ligging, nie die gesamentlike bedrag nie. Sit X02 opsy, die ongoedgekeurde aansoek van R500.00. Hou die twee uitgereikte fakture X03/X04 as skakels na verwagte koperontvangste; moenie elke faktuur en sy uiteindelike ontvangs as twee invloeie tel nie. Die vergelyking van gesinstyd is ook nie 'n betaling nie.

key:
In LATE, move only A's R600.00 receipt from 25 January to 28 February. Do not make a new receipt or change the sale value. The March closing remains R430.00, but the deepest gap grows from R220.00 to R310.00, after the 5 February trip payment. Equal end totals do not imply equal ability to pay on time.

In HIGH, increase B's input payment from R180.00 to R240.00, with no other change. In COMBINED, apply this increase and the late A receipt together. Do not add the individual scenario balances together: each scenario starts from the same opening position and recomputes the changed events. The combined deepest gap is R370.00 and the closing balance is R370.00.

draft:
Skuif in LATE slegs A se ontvangs van R600.00 van 25 Januarie na 28 Februarie. Moenie 'n nuwe ontvangs maak of die verkoopwaarde verander nie. Die Maart-slotsaldo bly R430.00, maar die diepste gaping groei van R220.00 na R310.00, ná die betaling vir die rit op 5 Februarie. Gelyke eindtotale impliseer nie gelyke vermoë om betyds te betaal nie.

Verhoog in HIGH B se insetbetaling van R180.00 na R240.00, met geen ander verandering nie. Pas in COMBINED hierdie verhoging en die laat A-ontvangs saam toe. Moenie die individuele scenariosaldo's bymekaar tel nie: elke scenario begin by dieselfde openingsposisie en bereken die veranderde gebeure weer. Die gesamentlike diepste gaping is R370.00 en die slotsaldo is R370.00.

key: DEFER moves the proposed R250.00 equipment purchase to 10 April, assuming the purchase date can actually be changed by agreement. It improves the March closing figure to R680.00 but leaves January's R220.00 gap. It therefore does not solve that earlier problem. A response must work before the shortage: possible options to investigate include changing the scale and associated costs/revenue, agreeing timing with the buyer or supplier, or identifying genuinely available funds. Do not simply delete essential inputs, assume a buyer pays early, cut basic household needs, or treat an unapproved application as available cash. Borrowing requires its full terms and a repayment plan; this unit recommends no lender or loan size.

Dit verbeter die Maart-slotsyfer na R680.00 maar laat Januarie se gaping van R220.00. Dit los daardie vroeër probleem dus nie op nie. 'n Reaksie moet vóór die tekort werk: moontlike opsies om te ondersoek, sluit in om die skaal en gepaardgaande koste/inkomste te verander, tydsberekening met die koper of verskaffer ooreen te kom, of werklik beskikbare fondse te identifiseer. Moenie net noodsaaklike insette uitvee, aanneem dat 'n koper vroeg betaal, basiese huishoudelike behoeftes sny, of 'n ongoedgekeurde aansoek as beskikbare kontant behandel nie. Lenings vereis hul volle voorwaardes en 'n terugbetalingsplan; hierdie eenheid beveel geen lener of leninggrootte aan nie.

key: Give the learner LATE and DEFER without the answer table. Ask which date first fails, whether the proposed equipment deferral solves it, and what evidence would be needed for a different response. Then present a real unknown quote: accept “cannot calculate yet” with a precise source request. Do not reward a guessed zero for producing a tidy budget.

Bied dan 'n werklike onbekende kwotasie aan: aanvaar “kan nog nie bereken nie” met 'n presiese versoek om 'n bron. Moenie 'n geraaide nul beloon omdat dit 'n netjiese begroting lewer nie.

key:
Bring a calculator, paper, date cards and counters. Read one card aloud at a time. Learners may point, move cards, explain aloud or ask a partner to write. Use the timeline for demonstration, then hide its answers for independent practice. Do not require anyone to share private household accounts, customer names or bank details.

All dates, amounts, working hours and offers are **invented classroom inputs**. January-March 2027 is a practice horizon, not a recommended South African growing season. Activities A and B have no specified crop, area or yield. Do not infer one. This is a new exercise, not a continuation of F1-F3 balances. The opening cash tin has R120.00 and the bank R180.00, both assumed available, with no restrictions or fees in the supplied model. The separate opening amounts owed are R120.00 by a customer and R80.00 to a supplier. Neither is opening cash.

A negative projected balance means the proposed sequence cannot be paid from the specified available funds. It is a warning to revise the plan or establish an appropriate, evidenced funding arrangement. It is not cash that exists, an approved overdraft or permission to miss a bill. Later balances describe an **unfunded projection**, not evidence that the intervening transactions could happen. Exact shortfall amounts are model results, not recommended loans or contingency reserves.

Gebruik die tydlyn vir demonstrasie en versteek dan sy antwoorde vir onafhanklike oefening. Moenie vereis dat enigiemand private huishoudelike rekeninge, kliëntname of bankbesonderhede deel nie.

Alle datums, bedrae, werkure en aanbiedinge is **versinde klaskamerinsette**. Januarie-Maart 2027 is 'n oefenhorison, nie 'n aanbevole Suid-Afrikaanse groeiseisoen nie. Choose Invoice type and, when asked, Existing sale record **before** entering buyer and line details. Changing either starts a fresh form in the current app. A new invoice begins a new document. Produce already sold and An invoice already written on paper ask whether the sale exists. Select the source sale when applicable; do not choose No merely to avoid matching it. An already invoiced sale should be reopened, not invoiced again. Preserve the original paper reference when the paper route asks for it.

Check buyer, product, quantity, unit, agreed price, growing area where relevant, dates and payment status. A suggested price is not evidence of the buyer's agreement. Keep bags and bunches as their actual units. The app can link paid kilogram lines into crop-sale evidence; it cannot infer the mass of other units. Existing-sale linking is limited by the supported source records. Do not split one past sale into invented new sales to make the form accept it.

Save, read the actual message, and reopen the same invoice from Saved or its sale link. Check its number, total, date and status. Documents are currently saved on the device within the account scope; crop-sale sync does not prove the complete invoice document is available on another device.

'n Verkoping wat reeds gefaktureer is, moet weer oopgemaak word, nie weer gefaktureer word nie. Bewaar die oorspronklike papierverwysing wanneer die papierroete daarvoor vra.

Kontroleer koper, produk, hoeveelheid, eenheid, ooreengekome prys, groeiarea waar tersaaklik, datums en betaalstatus. 'n Voorgestelde prys is nie bewys van die koper se ooreenkoms nie. Koppeling aan bestaande verkope word beperk deur die ondersteunde bronrekords. Moenie een vorige verkoping in versinde nuwe verkope verdeel om die vorm dit te laat aanvaar nie.

Stoor, lees die werklike boodskap, en maak dieselfde faktuur weer oop vanuit Gestoor of sy verkoopskakel. Kontroleer sy nommer, totaal, datum en status. 'n Stoor op die toestel met gewasverkoop-sinkronisering hangend is nie 'n rede om nog 'n faktuur te skep nie. Dokumente word tans op die toestel binne die rekening se omvang gestoor; sinkronisering van gewasverkope bewys nie dat die volledige faktuurdokument op 'n ander toestel beskikbaar is nie.

Let learners point, sort, explain aloud or ask a partner to write. Keep real customer names, account numbers and private receipts out of group discussion. The app tour uses sample records; these classroom amounts must not be entered in a learner's real farm.

Every amount and numbered day below is an **invented classroom input**. Each P case begins separately with no opening invoice, cash receipt, deposit or credit. A single invoice covers each completed delivery in these simplified cases. Real contract terms, tax treatment and disputed rights require appropriate review.

key:
The practice need is the same suitable tool service on Days 2, 10 and 20 within a 30-day horizon. Opening available cash is R500.00. Suitability, safe operation and access for BUY and HIRE are assumed confirmed solely to isolate the money exercise. SHARE has an unconfirmed Day 10 booking. No other receipts are supplied.

BUY pays R900.00 on Day 1, R60.00 for operating inputs on Day 10 and R40.00 for maintenance on Day 20. Total payments are R1,000.00. The plan is already R400.00 short on Day 1 and ends R500.00 short. It cannot be funded from the stated R500.00. The buyer would retain an asset, but its remaining value and useful life are unknown. Do not call the whole purchase an established 30-day cost of using up the tool, or assume the retained asset is worth zero. A future sale of that asset is not cash until its price, costs and date are evidenced.

HIRE pays R210.00 for all three uses, R60.00 transport and R150.00 refundable security on Day 1. These are three parts of one offer, not three separate R210.00 service fees. The exercise says operating and maintenance service costs are included, no other charges apply, and the R150.00 deposit is returned in full on Day 30. Cash needed first is R420.00, leaving R80.00. After the refund, net cash paid is R270.00 and closing cash is R230.00. A R270.00 net figure does not mean the farmer could start with only R270.00. The refund returns the farmer's money; it is not a produce sale.

SHARE pays R300.00 towards ownership on Day 1, R30.00 operating contribution on Day 10 and R20.00 maintenance contribution on Day 20. The conditional cash plan uses R350.00 and closes at R150.00. The retained share value is unknown. The unconfirmed booking means this offer has not yet been shown to meet the same need. A favourable cash total cannot resolve that availability problem.

draft:
Die oefenbehoefte is dieselfde geskikte gereedskapdiens op Dag 2, 10 en 20 binne 'n horison van 30 dae. Beskikbare openingskontant is R500.00. Geskiktheid, veilige werking en toegang vir BUY en HIRE word as bevestig aanvaar, uitsluitlik om die geldoefening te isoleer. SHARE het 'n onbevestigde bespreking op Dag 10. Geen ander ontvangste word verskaf nie.

BUY betaal R900.00 op Dag 1, R60.00 vir bedryfsinsette op Dag 10 en R40.00 vir onderhoud op Dag 20. Totale betalings is R1,000.00. Die plan kom reeds op Dag 1 R400.00 kort en eindig R500.00 kort. Dit kan nie uit die gestelde R500.00 befonds word nie. Die koper sou 'n bate behou, maar die oorblywende waarde en nuttige leeftyd daarvan is onbekend. Moenie die hele aankoop 'n vasgestelde 30-dae-koste van die opgebruik van die gereedskap noem nie, of aanneem dat die behoue bate niks werd is nie. 'n Toekomstige verkoping van daardie bate is nie kontant totdat sy prys, koste en datum bewys is nie.

HIRE betaal R210.00 vir al drie gebruike, R60.00 vervoer en R150.00 terugbetaalbare sekuriteit op Dag 1. Dit is drie dele van een aanbod, nie drie afsonderlike diensfooie van R210.00 nie. Die oefening sê bedryfs- en onderhoudsdienskoste is ingesluit, geen ander heffings is van toepassing nie, en die deposito van R150.00 word op Dag 30 ten volle terugbetaal. Kontant wat eerste nodig is, is R420.00, wat R80.00 oorlaat. Ná die terugbetaling is netto kontant betaal R270.00 en slotkontant R230.00. 'n Netto syfer van R270.00 beteken nie die boer kon met net R270.00 begin nie. Die terugbetaling gee die boer se geld terug; dit is nie 'n produkverkoping nie.

SHARE betaal R300.00 vir eienaarskap op Dag 1, R30.00 bedryfsbydrae op Dag 10 en R20.00 onderhoudsbydrae op Dag 20. Die voorwaardelike kontantplan gebruik R350.00 en sluit op R150.00. Die waarde van die behoue aandeel is onbekend. Die onbevestigde bespreking beteken daar is nog nie gewys dat hierdie aanbod aan dieselfde behoefte voldoen nie. 'n Gunstige kontanttotaal kan nie daardie beskikbaarheidsprobleem oplos nie.

Lê drie spasies uit: Kontant, Tydperkresultaat, Posisie. Wys R01. Skuif R200 van “kliënt skuld” na “kontant”; moenie 'n Januarie-verkoping byvoeg nie. Wys S01: voeg R900 by verkope en die kliëntsaldo; skuif R350 se voorraad na goederekoste. Kontant bly R950 ná P01. Die lopende resultaat is R550 voor latere koste en kontroles. Dan skuif R02 R600 van die kliëntsaldo na kontant. Verkope bly R900; R300 bly verskuldig. Hierdie model aanvaar dat die aflewering en aanvaarde faktuur daardie verkoping bewys; 'n bestelling of 'n onvervulde belofte alleen sou nie dieselfde bewys wees nie.

Gaan voort met L01: kontant en skuld styg albei met R500, terwyl die resultaat onveranderd bly. Gebruik die interaktiewe hulpmiddel een kaart op 'n slag. Nooi die leerder uit om te voorspel watter van die drie aansigte verander voordat jy vorentoe gaan. Vroeë kaarte wys 'n lopende resultaat uit die bewyse wat tot dusver verwerk is, nie 'n voltooide maand se wins nie.

Do not generalise this personal withdrawal into a rule about salaries in every business form.

L02 het twee dele: kapitaal verminder skuld; die rente van R10 is 'n tydperkkoste. H01 verminder kontant en die eienaar se ekwiteit; dit is hier nie 'n besigheidsuitgawe nie. Moenie hierdie persoonlike onttrekking veralgemeen tot 'n reël oor salarisse in elke besigheidsvorm nie.

key:
Use an invented pack, not a learner's private identifiers. Put an opening balance list, source documents, account statements, stock check, equipment and debt schedules, and unresolved items behind a one-page index. Give each a reference and period. Reconcile the index against the summaries. Mark missing items visibly. Keep actuals separate from forecasts. Do not ask learners to send private financial documents to a public class or to an unverified adviser.

Open the current official SARS pages in the source notes. Show how to record the page title, URL, date checked and the exact question. For example: which business form and registrations apply; what records are required; which retention conditions apply; whether an invoice has the required particulars for the relevant supply; and whether electronic storage arrangements meet the applicable requirements. This is an evidence-finding exercise, not a conclusion that a particular learner must register or can discard records. Retain source documents while questions remain unresolved. Do not teach a universal destruction date from a short web table.
