draft:
Gebruik 'n versinde pakket, nie 'n leerder se private identifiseerders nie. Sit 'n lys van openingsaldo's, brondokumente, rekeningstate, voorraadkontrole, toerusting- en skuldskedules, en onopgeloste items agter 'n indeks van een bladsy. Gee elkeen 'n verwysing en tydperk. Versoen die indeks met die opsommings. Merk ontbrekende items sigbaar. Hou werklike syfers afsonderlik van vooruitskattings. Moenie leerders vra om private finansiële dokumente na 'n openbare klas of 'n ongeverifieerde adviseur te stuur nie.

Maak die huidige amptelike SARS-bladsye in die bronnotas oop. Wys hoe om die bladsytitel, URL, datum nagegaan en die presiese vraag aan te teken. Byvoorbeeld: watter besigheidsvorm en registrasies van toepassing is; watter rekords vereis word; watter bewaringsvoorwaardes van toepassing is; of 'n faktuur die vereiste besonderhede vir die betrokke lewering het; en of elektroniese bergingsreëlings aan die toepaslike vereistes voldoen. Dit is 'n oefening om bewyse te vind, nie 'n gevolgtrekking dat 'n bepaalde leerder moet registreer of rekords kan weggooi nie. Behou brondokumente terwyl vrae onopgelos bly. Moenie 'n universele vernietigingsdatum uit 'n kort webtabel leer nie.

key:
Discuss four cards:

1. “The app printed a VAT number, so this is a valid tax invoice.” **Not established.** A field or title alone does not establish registration, supply treatment or all required particulars. Inspect the document with the applicable current guidance.
2. “I did not need to submit a return, so no records are needed.” **Not established.** Do not infer all record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. “My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan.” **Not established.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not establish completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. “A missing stock value should be zero.” **Incorrect.** Request the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.

draft:
Bespreek vier kaarte:

1. “Die app het 'n BTW-nommer gedruk, so dit is 'n geldige belastingfaktuur.” **Nie bewys nie.** 'n Veld of titel alleen bewys nie registrasie, die hantering van die lewering of al die vereiste besonderhede nie. Ondersoek die dokument met die toepaslike huidige riglyne.
2. “Ek hoef nie 'n opgawe in te dien nie, so geen rekords is nodig nie.” **Nie bewys nie.** Moenie al die rekordpligte uit daardie feit aflei nie. Vra oor die toepaslike vereistes en enige voortgesette oudit-, geskil- of ander verpligting.
3. “My uitvoer is 'n volledige stel rekeninge en waarborg 'n lening.” **Nie bewys nie.** Kontroleer dit teen die ander bewyse. 'n Uitvoer bewys nie volledigheid, kredietwaardigheid of goedkeuring nie.
4. “'n Ontbrekende voorraadwaarde moet nul wees.” **Verkeerd.** Vra vir die telling, waardasie en rekonsiliasie. Moenie ontbrekende inligting as 'n gemete resultaat vermom nie.

key: Reopen the appropriate saved invoice and inspect its details without sending it. Use the invoice companion and, when available, the export companion. Prepare a private evidence index and questions for appropriate local help. Keep a readable copy and recovery plan for needed records. Do not assume a device-local document has synchronised to another device, or that a course completion badge certifies the business's accounts.

draft: Maak die gepaste gestoorde faktuur weer oop en ondersoek sy besonderhede sonder om dit te stuur. Gebruik die faktuur-metgesel en, wanneer beskikbaar, die uitvoer-metgesel. Berei 'n private bewysindeks en vrae vir gepaste plaaslike hulp voor. Hou 'n leesbare kopie en herstelplan vir nodige rekords. Moenie aanneem dat 'n dokument wat plaaslik op 'n toestel is, na 'n ander toestel gesinkroniseer het nie, of dat 'n kursusvoltooiingskenteken die besigheid se rekeninge sertifiseer nie.

key:
For January, Plan A forecasts sales of R480 and operating payments of R280. Plan B forecasts R600 and operating payments of R480. Their included cash surpluses are R200 and R120 respectively, assuming all forecast sales are paid within the period. These are not full profits: closing stock, equipment use, overheads and unpaid work are not completely supplied. Do not treat the omitted costs as zero. Do not compare R12 per kg with R30 per item as though the larger number identifies the better enterprise.

Each alternative starts with R300. A's quoted payments leave R120 on 5 January, R80 on 10 January and R20 on 20 January. The assumed R480 payment on 30 January brings its closing projection to R500. B's payments leave R20, then an unfunded -R120, then -R180; its assumed receipt brings the closing projection to R420. A positive closing forecast does not make those earlier B payments fundable. The negative amounts are projected gaps, not an assertion that a physical cash tin held negative notes or that an overdraft was approved.

The supplied work plan allows eight owner hours. A requires six; B requires ten in addition to its paid helper. B has a two-hour owner-time gap. Those are exercise capacities, not recommended work rates. A's apparent fit does not establish that a real farm has sufficient land, water, skills, labour or permissions. Check each real constraint separately using suitable local evidence.

draft:
Vir Januarie voorspel Plan A verkope van R480 en bedryfsbetalings van R280. Plan B voorspel R600 en bedryfsbetalings van R480. Hul ingesluite kontantoorskotte is onderskeidelik R200 en R120, met die aanname dat alle voorspelde verkope binne die tydperk betaal word. Dit is nie volle winste nie: slotvoorraad, gebruik van toerusting, oorhoofse koste en onbetaalde werk word nie volledig verskaf nie. Moenie die weggelate koste as nul behandel nie. Moenie R12 per kg met R30 per item vergelyk asof die groter getal die beter onderneming aandui nie.

Elke alternatief begin met R300. A se gekwoteerde betalings laat R120 op 5 Januarie, R80 op 10 Januarie en R20 op 20 Januarie. Die aangenome betaling van R480 op 30 Januarie bring sy slotprojeksie op R500. B se betalings laat R20, dan 'n onbefondsde -R120, dan -R180; sy aangenome ontvangs bring die slotprojeksie op R420. 'n Positiewe slotvooruitskatting maak daardie vroeër B-betalings nie befondsbaar nie. Die negatiewe bedrae is geprojekteerde gapings, nie 'n bewering dat 'n fisiese kontantblik negatiewe note gehou het of dat 'n oortrekking goedgekeur is nie.

Die verskafde werkplan laat agt uur van die eienaar toe. A vereis ses; B vereis tien bykomend tot sy betaalde helper. B het 'n gaping van twee uur in die eienaar se tyd. Dit is oefenkapasiteite, nie aanbevole werktempo's nie. A se skynbare pas bewys nie dat 'n werklike plaas genoeg grond, water, vaardighede, arbeid of toestemmings het nie. Kontroleer elke werklike beperking afsonderlik met geskikte plaaslike bewyse.

key: If sales become profit, put the excluded-cost card beside the surplus. If January's final cash hides the earlier gap, replay B one bill at a time. If the learner calls an enquiry an order, point to its conditional wording. Use a new example after correction; do not give a pass for repeating the model's answer.

If the learner calls an enquiry an order, point to its conditional wording. Use a new example after correction; do not give a pass for repeating the model's answer.
draft: As verkope wins word, sit die kaart met uitgeslote koste langs die oorskot. As Januarie se finale kontant die vroeër gaping verberg, speel B een rekening op 'n slag weer. As die leerder 'n navraag 'n bestelling noem, wys na die voorwaardelike bewoording daarvan. Gebruik 'n nuwe voorbeeld ná regstelling; moenie 'n slaagpunt gee vir die herhaling van die model se antwoord nie.

key:
Build eight short sections: purpose and chosen activity; market evidence; site and resource access; work and delivery sequence; cost assumptions; dated cash forecast; risks and responses; review actions. Give every significant figure a reference, date, unit, scope and status. Mark a quotation as a quotation, an enquiry as an enquiry and an actual payment as a record. Keep an original plan version and a date for revisions. Explain the business in plain language before presenting the numbers.

For A, connect the three quote cards to the cash line and its assumed buyer payment. Keep B as a genuine alternative, with its hours and earlier cash gap visible. Do not combine the two R300 opening balances. A funding application F-ASK for R180 has no approval, terms or disbursement date. It does not fill B's gap. Even an approval may have conditions and timing to check; this lesson gives no approval or borrowing recommendation. F6 supplies questions for reading actual finance terms.

draft:
Bou agt kort afdelings: doel en gekose aktiwiteit; markbewyse; terrein en toegang tot hulpbronne; werk- en afleweringsvolgorde; koste-aannames; gedateerde kontantvooruitskatting; risiko's en reaksies; hersieningsaksies. Gee elke betekenisvolle syfer 'n verwysing, datum, eenheid, omvang en status. Merk 'n kwotasie as 'n kwotasie, 'n navraag as 'n navraag en 'n werklike betaling as 'n rekord. Hou 'n oorspronklike planweergawe en 'n datum vir hersienings. Verduidelik die besigheid in eenvoudige taal voordat jy die getalle aanbied.

Koppel vir A die drie kwotasiekaarte aan die kontantlyn en sy aangenome koperbetaling. Hou B as 'n werklike alternatief, met sy ure en vroeër kontantgaping sigbaar. Moenie die twee openingsaldo's van R300 kombineer nie. 'n Befondsingsaansoek F-ASK vir R180 het geen goedkeuring, voorwaardes of uitbetalingsdatum nie. Dit vul nie B se gaping nie. Selfs 'n goedkeuring kan voorwaardes en tydsberekening hê wat nagegaan moet word; hierdie les gee geen goedkeuring of aanbeveling om te leen nie. F6 verskaf vrae om werklike finansieringsvoorwaardes te lees.

key:
Move A's entire assumed R480 receipt to 5 February, retaining January's cost dates. January now has no buyer receipt and ends at R20. The projected sale remains R480; payment timing changed, not the quantity or price. The amount remains expected from the buyer at the window's end under this scenario. This is a January horizon, not a full next-season plan: later bills and obligations still need their own dated rows. A real forecast should cover the relevant operating cycle and commitments, rather than copying this short exercise horizon blindly.

A response must be specific and checked. For example, ask the buyer to confirm terms, then record any actual agreement and recalculate; obtain a genuine alternative transport quote; reconsider the proposed quantity against capacity. Do not assume a deposit, delay a supplier's bill without agreement, cut necessary care or insert hoped-for funding as certain income. Explain the effects on quality, workload, household needs and others before adopting a change.

Explain the effects on quality, workload, household needs and others before adopting a change.
draft:
Skuif A se hele aangenome ontvangs van R480 na 5 Februarie, en behou Januarie se kostedatums. Januarie het nou geen koperontvangs nie en eindig by R20. Die geprojekteerde verkoping bly R480; die betaaltyd het verander, nie die hoeveelheid of prys nie. Die bedrag word onder hierdie scenario steeds aan die einde van die tydperk van die koper verwag. Dit is 'n Januarie-horison, nie 'n volledige plan vir die volgende seisoen nie: latere rekenings en verpligtinge het steeds hul eie gedateerde rye nodig. 'n Werklike vooruitskatting moet die tersaaklike bedryfsiklus en verpligtinge dek, eerder as om hierdie kort oefenhorison blindelings te kopieer.

'n Reaksie moet spesifiek en nagegaan wees. Vra byvoorbeeld die koper om voorwaardes te bevestig, teken dan enige werklike ooreenkoms aan en bereken weer; kry 'n werklike alternatiewe vervoerkwotasie; heroorweeg die voorgestelde hoeveelheid teen kapasiteit. Moenie 'n deposito aanneem, 'n verskaffer se rekening sonder ooreenkoms uitstel, noodsaaklike versorging sny of gehoopte befondsing as seker inkomste invoeg nie. Verduidelik die gevolge vir gehalte, werklading, huishoudelike behoeftes en ander voordat 'n verandering aanvaar word.

key: A learner submits a polished map, a screenshot of R420 closing projected cash and the R180 application. Explain why these do not prove land rights, earlier liquidity, profitability or funding approval. Ask for the dated B payments and the missing work-hour arrangement. Then give A's delayed receipt case without the answer and ask the learner to build January cash. They must leave the February receipt outside January.

Explain why these do not prove land rights, earlier liquidity, profitability or funding approval. Ask for the dated B payments and the missing work-hour arrangement. Then give A's delayed receipt case without the answer and ask the learner to build January cash. They must leave the February receipt outside January.
draft: 'n Leerder dien 'n gepoleerde kaart in, 'n skermskoot van R420 geprojekteerde slotkontant en die aansoek van R180. Verduidelik waarom dit nie grondregte, vroeër likiditeit, winsgewendheid of goedkeuring van befondsing bewys nie. Vra vir die gedateerde B-betalings en die ontbrekende reëling vir werkure. Gee dan A se geval van vertraagde ontvangs sonder die antwoord en vra die leerder om Januarie se kontant op te bou. Hulle moet die Februarie-ontvangs buite Januarie laat.

key:
Actual A has 36 kg delivered at R11 per kg on 25 January, an invoice for R396. R300 arrives on 30 January, leaving R96 owed at 31 January. The remaining R96 arrives on 5 February; it is not January cash. Actual payments are purchase R180, packaging R50 and transport R80, totalling R310. An evidenced R20 owner contribution arrives on 15 January from outside this business cash scope. It is not a sale or loan. Starting with R300, the actual cash sequence is R120, R70, R90, R10 and R310. ACT-C1 reconciles the final R310 to the cash count and statement evidence. This complete model has no unfunded actual negative balance.

The closing forecast was R500; checked actual closing cash is R310, a R190 decrease against that forecast. Do not call this R190 a business loss. The sales-value difference is R84, and neither difference establishes full profit. Use the visual bridge in this stated order:

- Quantity effect: (36 - 40) kg at the planned R12 per kg = -R48.
- Price effect: 36 actual kg at (R11 - R12) per kg = -R36.
- Unpaid January balance: -R96 of the invoiced amount is not yet received.
- Purchase payment difference: R180 versus R180, no change.
- Packaging payment difference: R50 versus R40 reduces cash by R10.
- Transport payment difference: R80 versus R60 reduces cash by R20.
- Owner contribution adds R20 cash, not sales.

R500 - R48 - R36 - R96 - R10 - R20 + R20 = R310. The quantity and price effects sum to the R84 sales difference. This decomposition values the quantity change at planned price and the price change at actual quantity; different valid ordering allocates the interaction differently. It is arithmetic attribution, not proof of cause. The records do not say why fewer kilos sold or why the price changed. Do not invent crop failure, poor effort, buyer misconduct or weather as the explanation. Investigate using appropriate evidence.

draft:
Werklike A het 36 kg afgelewer teen R11 per kg op 25 Januarie, 'n faktuur vir R396. R300 kom op 30 Januarie in, wat R96 verskuldig laat op 31 Januarie. Die oorblywende R96 kom op 5 Februarie in; dit is nie Januarie-kontant nie. Werklike betalings is aankoop R180, verpakking R50 en vervoer R80, altesaam R310. 'n Bewysgesteunde eienaarsbydrae van R20 kom op 15 Januarie in van buite hierdie besigheid se kontantomvang. Dit is nie 'n verkoping of lening nie. Met 'n begin van R300 is die werklike kontantvolgorde R120, R70, R90, R10 en R310. ACT-C1 versoen die finale R310 met die kontanttelling en staatbewyse. Hierdie volledige model het geen onbefondsde werklike negatiewe saldo nie.

Die slotvooruitskatting was R500; nagegaande werklike slotkontant is R310, 'n afname van R190 teenoor daardie vooruitskatting. Moenie hierdie R190 'n besigheidsverlies noem nie. Die verskil in verkoopwaarde is R84, en geeneen van die verskille bewys volle wins nie. Gebruik die visuele brug in hierdie gestelde volgorde:

- Hoeveelheidseffek: (36 - 40) kg teen die beplande R12 per kg = -R48.
- Pryseffek: 36 werklike kg teen (R11 - R12) per kg = -R36.
- Onbetaalde Januarie-saldo: -R96 van die gefaktureerde bedrag is nog nie ontvang nie.
- Verskil in aankoopbetaling: R180 teenoor R180, geen verandering nie.
- Verskil in verpakkingsbetaling: R50 teenoor R40 verminder kontant met R10.
- Verskil in vervoerbetaling: R80 teenoor R60 verminder kontant met R20.
- Eienaarsbydrae voeg R20 kontant by, nie verkope nie.

R500 - R48 - R36 - R96 - R10 - R20 + R20 = R310. Die hoeveelheids- en pryseffekte tel op tot die verkoopsverskil van R84. Hierdie ontleding waardeer die hoeveelheidsverandering teen beplande prys en die prysverandering teen werklike hoeveelheid; 'n ander geldige volgorde deel die wisselwerking anders toe. Dit is rekenkundige toeskrywing, nie bewys van oorsaak nie. Die rekords sê nie waarom minder kilo's verkoop het of waarom die prys verander het nie. Moenie misoes, swak inspanning, wangedrag van die koper of weer as die verklaring versin nie. Ondersoek met gepaste bewyse.

key: Trace every bridge step back to its source. Ask why the invoice and its two receipts are not three sales, and why the owner contribution does not increase product revenue. Keep January and February windows visible. If a learner changes the plan quantity to 36, restore the original 40 before comparing. Ask for a reasoned next action such as confirming quality/demand and payment terms, checking current quotes, and fitting work to available hours. The actual R11 and 36 kg inform an enquiry; they do not guarantee next month's price or sales.

Ask for a reasoned next action such as confirming quality/demand and payment terms, checking current quotes, and fitting work to available hours. The actual R11 and 36 kg inform an enquiry; they do not guarantee next month's price or sales.
draft: Volg elke brugstap terug na sy bron. Vra waarom die faktuur en sy twee ontvangste nie drie verkope is nie, en waarom die eienaarsbydrae nie produkinkomste verhoog nie. Hou die Januarie- en Februarie-tydperke sigbaar. As 'n leerder die planhoeveelheid na 36 verander, herstel die oorspronklike 40 voordat vergelyk word. Vra vir 'n beredeneerde volgende aksie soos die bevestiging van gehalte/vraag en betaalvoorwaardes, die nagaan van huidige kwotasies, en die aanpassing van werk by beskikbare ure. Die werklike R11 en 36 kg lig 'n navraag in; dit waarborg nie volgende maand se prys of verkope nie.

key: Hide the amount on ACT-P2 and remove ACT-C1's closing reconciliation. Packaging was paid but its amount is unavailable. Full payments, closing cash, the cash difference and deepest gap now remain unknown. Sales of R396 and the January customer balance of R96 stay supported. Do not use the other case's R310 closing figure to reconstruct the missing amount. With a separate trustworthy closing reconciliation, a discrepancy could be investigated; this case deliberately does not supply one. Keep a request for the receipt and reconciliation open.

Do not use the other case's R310 closing figure to reconstruct the missing amount. With a separate trustworthy closing reconciliation, a discrepancy could be investigated; this case deliberately does not supply one. Keep a request for the receipt and reconciliation open.
draft: Versteek die bedrag op ACT-P2 en verwyder ACT-C1 se slotrekonsiliasie. Verpakking is betaal, maar die bedrag daarvan is nie beskikbaar nie. Volle betalings, slotkontant, die kontantverskil en diepste gaping bly nou onbekend. Verkope van R396 en die Januarie-kliëntsaldo van R96 bly ondersteun. Moenie die ander geval se slotsyfer van R310 gebruik om die ontbrekende bedrag te rekonstrueer nie. Met 'n afsonderlike betroubare slotrekonsiliasie kon 'n teenstrydigheid ondersoek word; hierdie geval verskaf doelbewus nie een nie. Hou 'n versoek vir die kwitansie en rekonsiliasie oop.

key: Return to the separate items case. Plan: ten items at R15, R60 payments, R80 opening. Actual: eight items at R14, R90 received, R70 payments and R20 contributed by the owner; no other movements or opening customer balance. Find actual sales, customer balance, closing cash and the difference from plan. Decompose the sales change with the same order as the demonstration. Then remove the actual cost evidence and ask which answers remain supported. Do not label a missing amount zero.
english: Return to the separate items case. Plan: ten items at R15, R60 payments, R80 opening. Actual: eight items at R14, R90 received, R70 payments and R20 contributed by the owner; no other movements or opening customer balance. Find actual sales, customer balance, closing cash and the difference from plan. Decompose the sales change with the same order as the demonstration. Then remove the actual cost evidence and ask which answers remain supported. Do not label a missing amount zero.
draft: Gaan terug na die afsonderlike itemsgeval. Plan: tien items teen R15, R60 betalings, R80 opening. Werklik: agt items teen R14, R90 ontvang, R70 betalings en R20 deur die eienaar bygedra; geen ander bewegings of openingsaldo van kliënte nie. Vind werklike verkope, kliëntsaldo, slotkontant en die verskil van die plan. Ontleed die verkoopsverandering in dieselfde volgorde as die demonstrasie. Verwyder dan die bewyse van werklike koste en vra watter antwoorde ondersteun bly. Moenie 'n ontbrekende bedrag nul noem nie.

key: The learner must produce R112 sales, R22 still owed and R120 closing cash against the R170 plan, a -R50 cash difference. Sales quantity effect is -R30 and price effect -R8, totalling -R38. Closing bridge: R170 - R30 - R8 - R22 - R10 + R20 = R120. Correct explanations distinguish product sales, money received, owner funds and the period. If a concept is missed, give corrective feedback and a new small source set; do not change the old answer to count it as independent success.
english: The learner must produce R112 sales, R22 still owed and R120 closing cash against the R170 plan, a -R50 cash difference. Sales quantity effect is -R30 and price effect -R8, totalling -R38. Closing bridge: R170 - R30 - R8 - R22 - R10 + R20 = R120. Correct explanations distinguish product sales, money received, owner funds and the period. If a concept is missed, give corrective feedback and a new small source set; do not change the old answer to count it as independent success.
draft: Die leerder moet R112 verkope, R22 nog verskuldig en R120 slotkontant lewer teenoor die plan se R170, 'n kontantverskil van -R50. Die hoeveelheidseffek op verkope is -R30 en die pryseffek -R8, altesaam -R38. Slotbrug: R170 - R30 - R8 - R22 - R10 + R20 = R120. Korrekte verduidelikings onderskei produkverkope, geld ontvang, eienaarsfondse en die tydperk. As 'n konsep gemis word, gee regstellende terugvoer en 'n nuwe klein stel bronne; moenie die ou antwoord verander om dit as onafhanklike sukses te tel nie.

key: Write a short review with the original assumption, actual evidence, explained difference, unresolved question, next action, responsible person and review date. Use the Charts guide to check each display's time window and cost scope. The app's single paid-in-full date does not reproduce this partial-payment history; keep the settlement schedule separately and do not mark a deposit as full payment. Do not enter invented classroom figures into a real farm's records.
english: Write a short review with the original assumption, actual evidence, explained difference, unresolved question, next action, responsible person and review date. Use the Charts guide to check each display's time window and cost scope. The app's single paid-in-full date does not reproduce this partial-payment history; keep the settlement schedule separately and do not mark a deposit as full payment. Do not enter invented classroom figures into a real farm's records.
draft: Skryf 'n kort hersiening met die oorspronklike aanname, werklike bewyse, verklaarde verskil, onopgeloste vraag, volgende aksie, verantwoordelike persoon en hersieningsdatum. Gebruik die Grafieke-gids om elke vertoning se tydperk en koste-omvang na te gaan. Die app se enkele ten volle betaal-datum gee nie hierdie geskiedenis van gedeeltelike betalings weer nie; hou die vereffeningskedule afsonderlik en moenie 'n deposito as volle betaling merk nie. Moenie versinde klaskamersyfers in 'n werklike plaas se rekords invoer nie.

key:
The learner presents an original/revised plan pair with: one market evidence sheet; a resource and access check; an activity budget with exclusions; dated cash rows; a delivery/invoice/payment trail; a cost evidence index; an actual-versus-plan review; and a next-action register. Use only systems relevant to that learner. A farming plan needs appropriate land, resource and technical evidence beyond this market exercise. The map and app records can support the pack but cannot replace those checks.

Assess whether the learner can detect an unconfirmed buyer assumption, an unfunded early payment, double-counted income, unlike units, an unpaid invoice counted as cash, an owner contribution called sales, an out-of-period receipt, missing costs presented as zero and a forecast presented as actual. Record the evidence of performance, feedback and next practice. Do not claim accounting competence, business viability, accreditation or funding approval from this classroom pack.
english:
The learner presents an original/revised plan pair with: one market evidence sheet; a resource and access check; an activity budget with exclusions; dated cash rows; a delivery/invoice/payment trail; a cost evidence index; an actual-versus-plan review; and a next-action register. Use only systems relevant to that learner. A farming plan needs appropriate land, resource and technical evidence beyond this market exercise. The map and app records can support the pack but cannot replace those checks.

Assess whether the learner can detect an unconfirmed buyer assumption, an unfunded early payment, double-counted income, unlike units, an unpaid invoice counted as cash, an owner contribution called sales, an out-of-period receipt, missing costs presented as zero and a forecast presented as actual. Record the evidence of performance, feedback and next practice. Do not claim accounting competence, business viability, accreditation or funding approval from this classroom pack.
draft:
Die leerder bied 'n paar oorspronklike/hersiene planne aan met: een markbewysblad; 'n kontrole van hulpbronne en toegang; 'n aktiwiteitsbegroting met uitsluitings; gedateerde kontantrye; 'n spoor van aflewering/faktuur/betaling; 'n indeks van kostebewyse; 'n hersiening van werklik teenoor plan; en 'n register van volgende aksies. Gebruik slegs stelsels wat vir daardie leerder tersaaklik is. 'n Boerderyplan het gepaste grond-, hulpbron- en tegniese bewyse nodig buiten hierdie markoefening. Die kaart en app-rekords kan die pakket ondersteun, maar kan nie daardie kontroles vervang nie.

Assesseer of die leerder 'n onbevestigde koperaanname, 'n onbefondsde vroeë betaling, dubbel getelde inkomste, ongelyksoortige eenhede, 'n onbetaalde faktuur wat as kontant getel is, 'n eienaarsbydrae wat verkope genoem word, 'n ontvangs buite die tydperk, ontbrekende koste wat as nul aangebied word en 'n vooruitskatting wat as werklik aangebied word, kan raaksien. Teken die bewyse van prestasie, terugvoer en volgende oefening aan. Moenie rekeningkundige bevoegdheid, besigheidslewensvatbaarheid, akkreditasie of goedkeuring van befondsing op grond van hierdie klaskamerpakket beweer nie.

key: Extent and levels are unmeasured; this is not a flood boundary.
english: Extent and levels are unmeasured; this is not a flood boundary.
draft: Omvang en vlakke is ongemeet; dit is nie 'n vloedgrens nie.

key: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
english: Name the missing evidence, a suitable way to obtain it, who can help and which decision depends on it. Keep unsafe or specialist work for appropriate help.
draft: Noem die ontbrekende bewyse, 'n geskikte manier om dit te kry, wie kan help en watter besluit daarvan afhang. Laat onveilige of gespesialiseerde werk vir gepaste hulp.

key: Ask the learner to explain a genuine trade-off between alternatives. More features or a prettier picture do not establish a better response to the brief.
english: Ask the learner to explain a genuine trade-off between alternatives. More features or a prettier picture do not establish a better response to the brief.
draft: Vra die leerder om 'n werklike afweging tussen alternatiewe te verduidelik. Meer kenmerke of 'n mooier prent bewys nie 'n beter reaksie op die opdrag nie.

key: Follow water, materials, people and care between features. Identify a useful connection and a possible conflict. Do not assume an output meets another part’s needs without checking suitability.
english: Follow water, materials, people and care between features. Identify a useful connection and a possible conflict. Do not assume an output meets another part’s needs without checking suitability.
draft: Volg water, materiale, mense en versorging tussen kenmerke. Identifiseer 'n nuttige verbinding en 'n moontlike botsing. Moenie aanneem dat 'n uitset aan 'n ander deel se behoeftes voldoen sonder om die geskiktheid daarvan na te gaan nie.

key: Use the same feature references as the drawings. Record measured quantities, quotation references, dates and when money is needed. Label estimates and missing costs. Refer to your finance worksheet; do not turn an unknown into zero.
english: Use the same feature references as the drawings. Record measured quantities, quotation references, dates and when money is needed. Label estimates and missing costs. Refer to your finance worksheet; do not turn an unknown into zero.
draft: Gebruik dieselfde kenmerkverwysings as die tekeninge. Teken gemete hoeveelhede, kwotasieverwysings, datums en wanneer geld nodig is, aan. Merk skattings en ontbrekende koste. Verwys na jou finansiewerkblad; moenie 'n onbekende in nul verander nie.

key: Ask what evidence would change the learner’s choice. Review a real explanation and revision record; filled boxes do not demonstrate competence or certify construction work.
english: Ask what evidence would change the learner’s choice. Review a real explanation and revision record; filled boxes do not demonstrate competence or certify construction work.
draft: Vra watter bewyse die leerder se keuse sou verander. Hersien 'n werklike verduideliking en hersieningsrekord; ingevulde blokkies demonstreer nie bevoegdheid nie en sertifiseer nie konstruksiewerk nie.

key: Choose observations connected to the household’s needs. Record the starting evidence, who agrees to observe, when or after which event, and what would prompt a review. Do not invent results.
english: Choose observations connected to the household’s needs. Record the starting evidence, who agrees to observe, when or after which event, and what would prompt a review. Do not invent results.
draft: Kies waarnemings wat aan die huishouding se behoeftes gekoppel is. Teken die beginbewyse aan, wie instem om waar te neem, wanneer of ná watter gebeurtenis, en wat 'n hersiening sou aanspoor. Moenie resultate versin nie.

key: Yes. The resident’s experience is useful evidence, and its source stays visible. It is not a measured contour or flood depth.
english: Yes. The resident’s experience is useful evidence, and its source stays visible. It is not a measured contour or flood depth.
draft: Ja. Die inwoner se ervaring is nuttige bewyse, en die bron daarvan bly sigbaar. Dit is nie 'n gemete kontoer of vloeddiepte nie.
